overall: Lavistar faces a growing threat from the Void, and the amnesiac Captain is asked to guide a new Voyager Savior Party through the Journey. Asherah, Smile, Luna and their allies follow trials that entangle them with missing family, ancient powers and rival plans for the world. Their travels reveal that the Journey and the forces they fight have deeper purposes than they first understood. In the West, Ceres and the Liberators confront a repeating battle and a painful choice about their homeland. Reunited, the allies face the Witch of Favoritism and an unresolved threat surrounding the Sword of Aldebaran.

stories.name: At the End of Starlight
stories.label: Prologue
stories.blurb: The end of all stars draws near. The Voyager Savior Party carries a single hope and advances toward the darkness.
stories.summary: Asherah, Luna and Smile enter a failing sanctuary while Voidborns overrun NOA. They seek the Star Savior's legacy to protect Lavistar. A familiar enemy awaits inside the darkened Hall of Stars. Elsewhere, Asherah approaches a stranger and calls them Captain.

chapters.s: Asherah, Luna and Smile enter Dirac's Well as NOA falls under attack. Lisa helps them open a route to the Hall of Stars.
A huge Voidborn blocks the entrance to the Hall of Stars. Asherah prepares the party to fight through.
The party reaches an empty, dark Hall of Stars. An enemy resembling Aldebaran appears, although Smile believes she was already defeated.
Asherah meets a stranger returning from work and calls them Captain. She points toward Lavistar before a bright light overwhelms them.

stories.name: Lavistar
stories.label: Episode 1
stories.blurb: Led by a mysterious girl, you find yourself in the world of Lavistar. Before you can grasp the situation, you must fend off a sudden monster attack.
stories.summary: The Captain awakens in NOA with missing memories and meets Asherah, an aspiring Savior. A Voidborn attack sends them to rescue the Observer Lisa. Their mission leads beneath the city, where Gille proves far stronger than they are. Alicia then appoints the Captain to guide Saviors through the Journey.

chapters.s: The Captain wakes in an unfamiliar city and meets Asherah. She offers to help with their lost memories while registering as a Savior.
Claire refuses Asherah's registration because of her family. A sudden Voidborn attack interrupts the argument, and Asherah volunteers to rescue an Observer.
Asherah gives the Captain a sword, which feels strangely familiar. They confront a spreading Void Rift on their way to the stranded Observer.
The Captain and Asherah rescue Lisa from a Rift Lord. Lisa agrees to register them as Saviors in return for help with Alicia's mission.
Lisa leads the pair to Dirac's Well to retrieve the Captain's weapon. Gille attacks, but a masked girl intervenes before the fight turns fatal.
Alicia appoints the Captain to recruit Saviors and lead the Journey against a coming disaster. In private, a mysterious visitor vows to destroy the Cycle.

stories.name: Happy Smile
stories.label: Episode 2
stories.blurb: The Voyager Savior Party takes on their first quest. Together with a girl who has a peculiar way of speaking, they chase after a con artist claiming to be an oracle...
stories.summary: The Captain forms the Voyager Savior Party with Asherah and takes a first quest to fund training. Smile hires them to recover money from Luna, an oracle who has gambled it away. The search instead leads to a dangerous clue about Smile's missing sister. Smile and Luna join the party after a battle that challenges Luna's faith in fixed fate.

chapters.s: Lisa becomes the Captain's liaison officer and explains their new duties. They head to Candle Square to begin work.
Asherah becomes the Captain's first recruit. Claire registers their group as the Voyager Savior Party, a name once used by the Star Savior.
Unable to afford training, the Captain and Asherah take a quest to catch a scammer. Their client is Smile, a young workshop owner.
Smile says an oracle took her workshop deposit to find her missing sister. The Captain and Asherah recognize the suspect as Luna.
Bell describes Luna's troublesome quests, which often end well despite complaints. She directs the party to a casino to find her.
The party finds Luna losing Smile's money at a casino. She admits the payment is gone and tries to escape.
After losing a fight, Luna agrees to lead Smile to a clue about her sister. She warns that following the clue will bring sorrow.
Luna leads the group to Starshard Fortress, where hired Raiders block their path. Asherah lets the defeated Raiders retreat.
Smile explains that her sister taught her to wish for a human heart. Despite Luna's warning, she chooses to keep searching.
The party meets an artificial being resembling Smile. It is corrupting the Heart of the Star and attacks anyone seeking its creator.
The party defeats a Void-powered enemy and hears from Smile's sister. The Captain encourages Smile to keep her wish alive; Smile and Luna join the party.

stories.name: Monolith Order
stories.label: Episode 3
stories.blurb: At last, the Voyager Savior Party takes their first step on the Journey. But a suspicious shadow is stalking them...
stories.summary: Muriel and Elisa recognize the Captain’s Star Piercer as a sacred relic of the Monolith Order. Muriel’s attempts to take it lead to a false bounty, a fight with Trish and a disastrous exchange involving the Cube Palace. The Captain meets Omega inside the sword and invites her to help recover her memories. Omega stops the damaged Cube Palace and joins the party, bringing a new training tool with her.

chapters.s: Muriel and Elisa spot the Star Piercer with the Captain and plan to claim it for the Monolith Order. Muriel hopes the discovery will improve her rank.
Muriel uses Elisa’s awkward attempt at affection to demand the Captain’s sword as compensation. The Captain refuses to give away a gift, and the saintesses retreat.

chapters.t: How to Handle a Cold City Man 1
chapters.s: A bandit-hunting quest sends the party into Trish’s path. Her own quest describes the Captain’s group as the bandits, and she attacks despite their protests.

chapters.t: How to Handle a Cold City Man 2
chapters.s: Muriel reveals that she arranged the false quests to pressure the Captain into surrendering the sword. When Trish is defeated, Muriel and Elisa try taking it themselves.
The Captain forgives Muriel after the false bounty is exposed at the Hunter Association. Muriel treats this mercy as a chance to try another scheme.
Muriel offers the Cube Palace for a chance to borrow the Star Piercer. When she refuses to return the sword, a struggle makes Elisa smash the relics together.
Inside the Star Piercer, the Captain meets Omega and invites her along. Omega stops the broken Cube Palace’s escaping copies and turns it into a training tool.

stories.name: The Name on the Gravestone
stories.label: Episode 4
stories.blurb: The Voyager Savior Party heads to the ancient city of Aganon for their first trial. But awaiting them is a massive, unidentified curse that blankets the ruins...
stories.summary: The Voyager party travels to Aganon for its first trial, where a curse has trapped people and constructs in an undying state. Bell discovers that her missing sister Carnelia is breaking a Heart of the Star in search of freedom from immortality. Carnelia reveals a hidden connection between their family, Mogulus and the world’s Cycle, while Bell chooses rescue over execution. The party defeats Mogulus, but Carnelia leaves with the Witch of Favoritism, and Bell vows to bring her sister home.

chapters.s: Bell remembers discovering that Carnelia could return from death and wanted proof she was alive. A confidential report points to a dangerous curse in Aganon.
Lisa assigns the Voyager party its first main trial: investigate the curse and ancient constructs in Aganon. Bell joins as their specialist in curses.
Claire gives Bell essential supplies and a maid’s handbook before the trip. Their private conversation hints that the mission concerns Carnelia’s disappearance.
Bandits stop the train to Aganon. The party and Lugh defeat them, while Lisa overpowers the leader after he damages her handbag.
Roberta explains Aganon’s worsening crisis. Marcille blocks the ruins over unpaid construction fees, then agrees to guide the party after testing Asherah’s strength.
Bell protects the group from the ruins’ immortality curse with grave wards. During an attack by the undying, her spell carries her and the injured Captain deeper underground.
Bell treats the Captain and explains that Carnelia fled Candle Square with the Light of Dawn. She suspects her sister caused the curse and believes she must execute her.
Carnelia admits accepting a quest to destroy the Heart of the Star in exchange for a chance to die. Bell chooses to arrest and help her, but Carnelia shatters the gem.
Carnelia reveals that Mogulus is their ancestor, sealed alive to support the world’s Cycle. She rejects becoming his replacement and awakens him to end her immortality.
Omega locates the Captain at the bottom of the ruins. Asherah leads the others in a risky jump down the unfinished elevator shaft to reach him.
Bell and the Captain save Carnelia from Mogulus, and the reunited party defeats him. Carnelia then leaves with the Witch of Favoritism to help destroy the Cycle.
After the trial, Bell shows the Captain her unfinished first gravestone. She carves Carnelia’s name as a promise to bring her home and let her live a full life.

stories.name: Lingering Wings on the Street
stories.label: Episode 5
stories.blurb: The Voyager Savior Party arrives in Monastir for the competition trial. However, their friendly meeting with the Monastir Knights is cut short when Tyria and her Voidborn forces attack the royal palace.
stories.summary: The Voyager party visits Monastir for a competition trial, but an attack led by the Executor Tyria interrupts the visit. A search for a royal weapon reveals a Heart of the Star and Frey’s identity as the duchy’s princess. Tyria admits that she wants to preserve her life among humans, and she joins the Knights and the party against Gille. The Captain, Charlotte and Tyria channel power into the gem to repel Gille, allowing Monastir’s daily life and the postponed trial to resume.

chapters.s: Frey takes Charlotte to the theater to practice social etiquette, then leaves on palace business. A poised stranger helps the nervous Charlotte find her seat.
The party travels to Monastir for its competition trial. Gille confronts Tyria, warns that Aldebaran will return and orders her to destroy the duchy’s Heart of the Star.
Charlotte, Carmen and Frey welcome the Voyager party to Monastir. Their preparations for a friendly trial are interrupted by a sudden Voidborn attack on the palace.
The Knights and Voyager party repel Tyria’s Voidborns. Tyria overwhelms them when confronted, but withdraws after noticing the Captain.
Monastir declares an emergency and postpones the trial. Frey offers to lead the restless party to an ancient royal weapon that might defeat an Executor.
After a difficult mountain climb, the party breaks a seal and finds a Heart of the Star. The arriving Knights reveal that Frey is the princess, and Tyria appears behind them.
Tyria fights the group over the gem, then admits Gille threatened to destroy Monastir. The Captain and Frey propose joining forces with her against Gille.
Charlotte meets Tyria at a restaurant and learns more about her attachment to Monastir’s ordinary life. Tyria later visits the party and accepts the alliance.

chapters.t: On the Eve of the Final Battle
chapters.s: The Captain finds Charlotte and Carmen training late before the operation. He reassures Charlotte, and their conversation gives the Knights a strange sense of familiarity.
Tyria lures Gille into a forest ambush with the Knights and Voyager party. Gille turns the battle toward Monastir, forcing the allies to chase her into the city.
The allies defend Monastir as Gille gains the upper hand. Tyria hesitates to damage the theater and is badly hurt, but Charlotte and Carmen shield her from a finishing attack.

chapters.t: The Path We Walk Becomes Light
chapters.s: Tyria explains how the Heart of the Star can repel Executors. With Frey’s relocated gem, the Captain, Charlotte and Tyria raise a barrier that drives Gille away.

chapters.t: The Path We Walk Becomes Light

chapters.s: The Voyager party completes its postponed competition trial against the Knights. Tyria returns to her familiar cafes and theater, choosing to enjoy the peace she helped protect.

stories.name: Rhapsody of Unbroken Blades
stories.label: Episode 6
stories.blurb: The Captain and the Voyager Savior Party head west on a special mission from Alicia. Awaiting them is Ceres, Commander of the Western Liberators, planning an assault on the Void Core.
stories.summary: The Void Trial sends Voyager west to support Ceres and the Western Liberators. A strange accident separates the party and traps the Captain in a repeating battle. Ceres and Lydia help uncover why each attempt fails and what the Void Core truly protects. The allies must choose between preserving a costly peace and facing an uncertain future together.

chapters.s: Ceres remembers the sacrifices made by her sister Venera and the Western Liberators. She prepares a new operation to reclaim the West.
Lisa sends Voyager west for the Void Trial. Alicia privately asks the Captain to prevent a direct attack on the Void Core.
A spacetime rift splits the party during a train journey. The Captain and Asherah meet the Western Liberators, who question their arrival.
Ceres confines the visitors and refuses to delay her attack on the Void Core. The Captain and Asherah resolve to intervene.
An unlocked door lets the pair follow Ceres into battle. After disaster strikes, the Captain awakens back at the train accident.
The Captain remembers repeated defeats and changes their approach. Helping inexperienced Liberators earns a warmer reception from Ceres.
Ceres describes dreams matching battles the Captain remembers. She accepts their warning but refuses to surrender her people's future to fate.
Asherah trusts the Captain's account of the loop. Following Lydia away from battle leads them beneath the Void Core's crash site.
Lydia explains how Kuku preserves her memories between loops. Her research suggests destroying the Void Core could unleash a greater danger.
The Captain risks linking with Kuku to investigate Olberos. Ceres is drawn into the same hidden space, where a familiar voice awaits.
Venera explains the seal within Olberos and the reason for the repeating battles. Her proposed solution places a painful choice before Ceres.
Ceres remembers the encounter across the next reset. With the Captain and Asherah, she chooses to challenge the fate imposed on the West.
The allies fight together to help Ceres reclaim her sword and face Olberos. Their victory ends the loop, while leaving a new threat ahead.

stories.name: The Witch's Veil
stories.label: Episode 7
stories.blurb: After a train accident, Luna, Smile, and Omega lose the Captain and Asherah. Their search leads them to a mysterious woman... casually sipping a drink atop the train.
stories.summary: While the Captain is trapped in the loop, Luna, Smile and Omega investigate the emptied West. Amora joins them, bringing knowledge of the threat behind the disaster and of the Journey itself. When the missing allies return, they unite to secure the Sword of Aldebaran. The Witch of Favoritism confronts them with unsettling claims about Lavistar, leaving the struggle unresolved.

chapters.s: Luna, Smile and Omega search for their missing companions after the train accident. They meet Amora, a powerful traveler who offers to accompany them.
The group finds Raven Wall and its nearby village deserted. Records suggest the disappearances occurred before the planned attack on the Void Core.
At the missing Void Core's site, Smile identifies a possible anchor to a separate spacetime. Omega senses the Captain nearby, but they cannot reach him.
Luna uses prophecy to investigate Amora. A glimpse of Asherah angry with her deepens Luna's suspicion, although the meaning remains unclear.
Amora explains that someone seeks the Sword of Aldebaran. After testing the party's resolve, she reveals her connection to Asherah and Alicia.
Amora describes the Journey as a ritual tied to Lavistar's survival. The Witch of Favoritism appears, and negotiations quickly fail.
Alicia's earlier request explains why Amora came west. As Voidborns fall across Lavistar, Alicia orders the Saviors to protect civilians.
The missing allies return and Voyager reunites. A family argument gives way to battle as the Sword of Aldebaran emerges and the Witch summons Demoraigis.
The combined allies defeat Demoraigis despite their exhaustion. The Witch responds by summoning two more powerful Voidborns.
Amora, Asherah and the Captain confront the Witch while the others defend the wounded. She overwhelms them and makes a disturbing claim about Lavistar.

stories.name: Pathfinder of Starlight
stories.label: Journey story
stories.summary: Lisa introduces the Captain to the Journey and explains how its members and first trial are arranged. Meetings around NOA bring supplies, an Arcana gift and an explanation of charms. Claire also offers a hunt quest that can provide experience and operating funds. These scenes connect the training routine with the people supporting it.

chapters.s: Lisa welcomes the Captain to the Journey, explains member selection and emphasizes balancing training, money and condition.
Lisa explains that the basic trial assesses the Journey member's abilities. Losing it will not end the run, and she offers a small preparation gift.
Lisette introduces the Apocalypse shop and its Journey supplies. She gives the Captain an Arcana and invites them to visit.
An unsigned package brings the Captain a choice of charms. Bell explains how relics tied to the Star Savior can gain power during the Journey.
Claire posts a hunt quest after Raiders attack food deliveries. She recommends it as a way to gain field experience and funds before the next trial.

stories.name: Candlelight, Rabbits, and a Banquet
stories.label: Event story
stories.summary: The Captain's welcome banquet is delayed when Bell sends an emergency message from the secret Deep Field casino. Claire and Scarlet disguise themselves as bunny attendants while the Voyager team creates a distraction outside. The rescue becomes a card-game challenge against Hubble, whose interest in the Captain goes beyond gambling. Everyone returns to Candle Square for the postponed celebration, while Bell's private reason for meeting Hubble raises further questions.

chapters.s: The Captain arrives for a welcome banquet and finds Claire and Scarlet preparing a disguised rescue mission. Bell has sent an emergency message from Deep Field.
Claire explains Bell's emergency code and Emily's discovery of a hidden casino. The Captain and Voyager team join the maids' rescue plan.
The Captain, Claire and Scarlet enter Deep Field, but Emily misses their meeting. The Captain bluffs past a demanding guest to keep the group together.
Luna gathers a crowd outside the hidden entrance, drawing guards away. Inside, the Captain's team uses the distraction to search deeper into the casino.
Annah arrives as the disturbance grows outside. Inside, a casino guest supports the Captain's cover story when a guard questions Claire and Scarlet.
The security chief identifies the rescue team as intruders and surrounds them. Claire and Scarlet prepare to fight their way through.
Hubble stops the fight and claims Bell accepted a business proposal. The casino owner challenges the Captain to a game with Bell's freedom at stake.
The team struggles against Hubble in a card game. Claire takes charge and turns a reckless draw into a win, urging everyone to trust their momentum.
Hubble unsettles Claire by mentioning her past, leaving the Captain to finish the game. Trusting his companions, he risks another card and wins Bell's release.
The team finds Bell resting comfortably and learns her meeting involved an information trade. As they leave, the angry security chief blocks their exit.
Claire and the others defeat the security chief, who ignored Hubble's order to let them leave. They resume their return to Candle Square.
The Voyager team brings Annah into the casino dispute and accidentally strikes the returning Captain. Everyone regroups safely and decides to hold the banquet immediately.
Emily arrives with the cake, completing the delayed welcome banquet. Later, Hubble asks about the Captain's winning gamble and hears how trust in his companions guided him.

stories.name: Does Omega Dream of Electric Friends?
stories.label: Event story
stories.summary: Left at home while Voyager attends a meeting, Omega sneaks into NOA with Cube Palace to look for more friends among ancient relics. Along the way, she teams up with Trish and meets Elisa, but Cube dismisses her search as a waste of energy. When Khan steals Cube, Omega's new friends help rescue him despite her dwindling power. The adventure teaches Omega how friendship can include irritation and disagreement as well as kindness.

chapters.s: Lonely while Voyager is away, Omega wants to visit a museum's ancient relics. She sneaks out and brings a reluctant Cube Palace along.
Omega explores NOA and tries to help Trish pay for repaired weapons. After a failed attempt to copy money, she makes daggers and agrees to work with Trish.

chapters.t: The Good, the Hopeful, and the Strange
chapters.s: Trish and Omega confront a gang of deserters turned robbers. Omega believes she can make them good again with her repair attacks.

chapters.t: The Good, the Hopeful, and the Strange Pt.2
chapters.s: Omega and Trish defeat the robbers and prepare to collect their bounty. Omega takes the criminals' frightened cooperation as proof that her repairs worked.
Omega earns museum money with Trish and spends some on a huge meal. As she explains wanting friends for Cube too, a stranger questions the captured robbers about her.
At the museum, Elisa shows Omega ancient relics but finds no new companions like her. Cube questions her search for friends, and a stranger approaches him when Omega leaves.
Elisa tells Omega about Cube's long isolation, helping her understand him. Omega returns to find Cube missing and tracks him to a warehouse.
Omega finds that Khan of Carbonpunk has stolen Cube to gain power. Khan refuses to release him, and Omega prepares to fight the robbers again.
Omega exhausts her energy while rescuing Cube, putting her projected body at risk. Trish, Muriel and Elisa come to help, but Khan corners the group as a storm begins.
Following Cube's plan, Omega recharges through a lightning strike. She projects a powerful launcher while her friends keep Khan occupied.
The group defeats Khan, and Omega thanks her friends. Cube admits he tried to protect her, while she explains why companionship matters beyond usefulness.
Voyager returns and learns that Omega sneaked out. The Captain gently hears about her adventure, and Omega falls asleep pleased with all the friends she made.

stories.name: New Year Under Starlit Trails
stories.label: Event story
stories.summary: Asherah receives an invitation to a New Year charity gala and decides to compete for a relic of the Star Savior. Epindel helps her prepare, turning their childhood friendship and differing views of duty into dance lessons and earnest conversations. After the dance, the relic releases a dangerous entity and forces the friends to fight together. A glimpse of the Star Savior's memories gives Asherah a new appreciation of the ordinary moments shared with trusted companions.

chapters.s: Voyager looks forward to NOA's New Year festival. A letter from House Stranis arrives for Asherah, raising worries that her family wants her home.
Asherah's mother invites her and her friends to a charity gala. A Star Savior relic offered as a dance prize persuades Asherah to attend with the Captain.
Scarlet's referral secures Asherah a custom dress at a busy boutique. There she meets Epindel, her childhood friend and the gala's organizer.
Epindel teaches Voyager formal manners and dancing. Asherah practices hard and explains that facing unfamiliar challenges is part of following her hero's example.
Voyager explores festival preparations and hears different accounts of the rocket-launch tradition. Roberta's team investigates a possible problem involving a relic.
The Captain challenges nobles gossiping about Asherah. She arrives in her dress, handles their remarks with confidence, and dances with him after all her practice.
Asherah and the Captain win a blank notebook relic, but his touch triggers a Void Rift. Voyager stays to protect the guests while Epindel oversees their evacuation.
A barrier traps Asherah and the Captain with the growing threat. Carrying the relic lets Epindel cross it, and she chooses to help her friends despite her servant's objections.
Epindel helps Asherah pursue the Captain after he is dragged into the rift. Within the relic, Asherah glimpses the Star Savior celebrating New Year with his companions.
Asherah and the Captain return through the relic's light, which heals them and weakens the sealed enemy. With Epindel, they prepare to finish the fight.
The friends defeat the entity and reunite with Voyager as the barrier falls. Asherah and the Captain thank Epindel for choosing to help them.
Everyone gathers for the delayed rocket launch. Asherah shares what the Star Savior's memories taught her and treasures the new memories she made with the Captain.

stories.name: Discordant Duet on the Black Snowfield
stories.label: Event story
stories.summary: Claire sends the increasingly forgetful Emily to Kalaid under the guise of an inspection, hoping she will rest. Emily meets Trish, whose hunt for a legendary beast leads them into a mystery involving hostile townspeople and black stones. The pair discover a Void plot at Candle Square, but their clashing approaches repeatedly put them at odds. By learning to combine caution with boldness, they save Kalaid and become unlikely friends.

chapters.s: Claire sends Emily to Kalaid after her mistakes disrupt Candle Square. Trish also sets out to hunt a reported Wendigo, while Polaris notices unusual readings there.
A snow-blocked train brings Emily and Trish together in a carriage. Their different ideas about preparation clash before monsters attack the road.
After defeating the monsters, Emily criticizes Trish's risky moves. Trish insists that looking impressive is part of a hunter's work.
Kalaid's people seem unusually hostile, and Emily finds the local Candle Square suspicious. The senior maid dismisses her concerns and gives Trish a lead on the Wendigo.
With the roads closed, Emily joins Trish's hunt despite doubts about her flashy gear. A huge creature appears as they debate whether to make camp.
Trish defeats the supposed Wendigo but begins to doubt what it is. Its falling body triggers an avalanche that sweeps both hunters away.
Carnelia rescues the pair and links the black stones to Kalaid's strange behavior. She describes Candle Square's hidden activities and warns them against returning.
Both Emily and Trish choose to return and help Kalaid, each expecting the other to leave. They follow suspicious maids toward Candle Square's annex.
Emily and Trish infiltrate the annex and find captives being replaced by copies made from dark energy. Their attempt to remove the source fails and exposes them.
The senior maid reveals a plan to spread the Void through star fragments. Captured Emily and Trish escape when a charm absorbs the dark energy, learning to value their differences.
Emily and Trish interrupt the senior maid's public ritual as Kalaid's people begin to change. Together they prepare to fight the creature within the giant stone.
The pair combine their strengths to destroy the core and free Kalaid from its influence. Roberta's arriving team finds them exhausted but alive on a roof.
Polaris keeps the incident secret, while Emily returns with clearer focus and a new hunting friend in Trish. Professor M brings home a mysterious black-stone souvenir.

stories.name: Bitter & Sweet! Golden Fantasia
stories.label: Event story
stories.summary: Charlotte asks the Captain to check on Frey, whose latest money-making plan takes her to Deep Field's Valentine's event. A mix-up leaves Frey holding legendary golden chocolate while a magician uses hypnosis to draw out the guests' desires. The Captain helps Charlotte and Frey resist by reminding them of the worthy goals behind their ambitions. Their escape also raises questions about how much Hubble allowed to happen in hopes of learning the Captain's secrets.

chapters.s: Worried about Frey's visit to Deep Field, Charlotte asks the Captain for help. His VIP status lets them enter the club to look for her.

chapters.t: B Is for Business... and Bunnies
chapters.s: Frey is selling premium chocolate while a magician plans a golden-chocolate show. Guards surround the group after the Captain's name mysteriously vanishes from the guest list.
Frey leads an escape before admitting she borrowed a staff outfit without permission. Charlotte and the Captain change disguises, but the guards still recognize their group.
Charlotte knocks out the guards, allowing the trio to flee. They pass strangely distracted staff and take shelter in Deep Field's event hall.
The magician's chocolate show sends the audience into a frenzy of desire. Frey discovers that the supposedly defective chocolate she carries is turning gold.
Frey realizes a box mix-up left her holding the real golden chocolate. The magician discovers the trio resisting and uses her tricks on Charlotte and Frey.
Charlotte and Frey reveal their wishes to the Captain under hypnosis. They briefly regain control, but the chocolate scent remains dangerous and a bewitched doorman blocks their way.
The freed doorman explains how the magician used chocolate and a finger snap to control him. The trio decides to stop her before more guests are affected.
The magician discovers her chocolate is fake while Frey's box glows gold. She turns the crowd against the trio and seizes control of Charlotte and Frey again.
The Captain defends the good behind Charlotte's and Frey's ambitions, helping them break free. They reclaim the golden chocolate, which he eats to keep it from the magician.
The golden chocolate seems to leave the Captain unharmed. Furious that her plan has failed, the magician confronts the group in a terrifying transformed shape.
After losing the fight, the magician probes the Captain's mind and is overwhelmed by what she finds. The crowd wakes, and Hubble returns as the trio considers what to do.
The Captain suspects Hubble let the trouble continue to investigate his mind. As compensation, Frey gains help selling her chocolates, and the trio ends Valentine's Day safely.

stories.name: The Monologue Must End
stories.label: Event story
stories.summary: Alicia sends the Captain, Asherah and Omega into a damaged timeline that threatens to affect Lavistar. In an ash-covered world, they meet Hilde and Yoo Mina and prepare to confront the powerful Rosaria. Shared hardships and a meal help bridge Mina's distrust, but the true source of the broken timeline proves more personal than anyone first expects. The visitors help Mina face her grief and choose to move forward with the people she still wants to protect.

chapters.s: An unstable encounter brings Mina before Hilde and Asmodeus. In Lavistar, Alicia sends the Captain, Asherah and Omega to close a scar formed by a dangerous alternate timeline.
The visitors arrive in an ash-covered world and are rescued by Yoo Mina. Hilde resolves Mina's suspicions and warns them about the powerful Demon Lord Asmodeus.
Rosaria attacks the group's shelter, forcing them to move. Omega starts repairing Hilde's damaged gear, but needs food and energy before she can finish.
The group crosses the wasteland toward another underground shelter. Mina's anger causes friction until hidden Voidborns launch an ambush.
The group defeats the ambush through teamwork and notices that Voidborn activity is increasing. They hurry onward in search of food and shelter.
While searching a supply base, Mina tells Asherah about the friends she lost. Hilde offers Omega cautious reassurance about her past, and the group finds food.
Cooking and sharing a meal eases the tension between the travelers. During their rest, Rosaria's Voidborns carry the sleeping Captain away.
Omega guides the rescue party toward the Captain as Hilde's repairs finish. Rosaria explains that she kidnapped him to draw Hilde into a fight, then listens to his Journey stories.
Rosaria easily destroys attacking Voidborns. Impatient for Hilde to arrive, she makes the Captain carry her across the wasteland to meet the rescue party.
Rosaria objects to having her actions limited by the rules of a turn. Her impatience offers a brief pause in the rescue's unfolding drama.
Rosaria protects the Captain from a Voidborn and speaks of her long rivalry with Hilde. Hilde finally arrives, and Rosaria demands a serious fight.
Rosaria hints that someone else shaped the situation. Asherah, Mina and Omega arrive, and the Captain takes command while Hilde prepares to face her.
Omega boosts Hilde's gear during the duel, but Rosaria continues the confrontation. Mina survives an apparently lethal attack, revealing that the world follows unusual rules tied to her.
Hilde and Rosaria explain that Mina's grief shaped a new timeline through the quantum tunnel. The group refuses to sacrifice her and asks Rosaria for another solution.
Rosaria draws out a shadow embodying Mina's regret. With her new allies beside her, Mina chooses to confront it and protect the people she still cares about.
The group defeats Mina's shadow, allowing the false world to fade. The visitors return to Alicia as Lavistar's scar heals, carrying the feelings of their new bonds.
Back in her own world, Mina remembers the encounter only as a precious dream. Visiting Narae's grave, she resolves to keep moving forward despite her grief.

stories.name: Wind, Moon, and Blade
stories.label: Event story
stories.summary: A request to guide visitors around NOA draws the Captain into the Wind Moon Sect's pursuit of Fei and a stolen martial manuscript. Lyn, Serpang and Toto must temporarily cooperate with Fei when martial artists seeking revenge surround them. Beneath the chase lies Lyn's hurt over the departure of the senior sister she once followed everywhere. The Captain encourages honest words as the two confront their different paths and the bonds that still connect them.

chapters.s: Lyn, Serpang and Toto arrive from the Eastern Continent. They have come to NOA to find Fei, an expelled disciple of the Wind Moon Sect.
The Captain receives a request to guide Wind Moon visitors around NOA. Before the meeting, Fei introduces herself and tries to recruit him to learn the Celestial Art.

chapters.t: Enemies Cross Paths in the Square
chapters.s: The Captain meets Lyn, Serpang and Toto and learns they seek a stolen manuscript. Fei appears during their tour, prompting Serpang and Toto to challenge her.

chapters.t: Enemies Cross Paths in the Square
chapters.s: Fei outwits Serpang and Toto before Tien, Xien and a crowd of martial artists attack her. Their many grievances leave the Captain wondering what Fei has done.
Lyn confronts Fei, who escapes amid the crowd. When Lyn refuses an alliance with Tien and Xien, they accuse the Wind Moon visitors and Captain of protecting Fei.
Lyn opens an escape route, but the pursuers keep closing in. Fei proposes a temporary alliance and leads the group through a secret tunnel outside NOA.
The group leaves the tunnel only to meet guards led by another martial artist who once lost to Fei. Their temporary alliance faces another fight.
The defeated guard explains that he only wanted to test his growth against Fei. Lyn questions the value of martial ambition, while her secret capture order is revealed.
At camp, Lyn easily befriends a young pursuer. Fei tells the Captain why she left the sect to restore the Celestial Art, while Lyn remembers their childhood closeness.
More pursuers become Fei's students after losing to her. Her praise and obsession with mastery upset Lyn, and Serpang asks the Captain to prevent the sisters from hurting each other.
Tien and Xien explain how their father's defeat by Fei ended their life together as martial disciples. They arrange a final duel, while Lyn and Fei nearly clash themselves.

chapters.t: If You Don't Say It, It Won't Be Understood
chapters.s: During a moonlit walk, Lyn recalls growing up beside Fei. The Captain encourages her to express the feelings she has kept hidden rather than expecting others to understand.
Fei leaves a farewell note and goes to face Tien and Xien alone. Lyn follows with the others and insists their alliance lasts until this final fight is settled.
Fei and Lyn defeat Tien and Xien, settling the grudge with an apology. Lyn then reveals her order to capture Fei dead or alive, and the sisters prepare to face each other.

chapters.t: The Wind Blows, and the Moon Shines
chapters.s: Their duel finally brings Lyn's hurt over being left behind into the open. Fei wins, apologizes for leaving without a farewell, and affirms that she never forgot their shared life.
The Captain returns to Voyager and tries being honest about Asherah's cooking. Lyn's group remains in NOA to continue seeking Fei, while everyone looks ahead to meeting again.

stories.name: Mock Trial
stories.label: Event story
stories.summary: Lisa arranges a funded sparring exercise for Voyager and promises an expensive dinner as its reward. Muriel and Elisa reluctantly become their opponents after being offered help finding sacred relics. Asherah and Luna's victory shows how much the party has improved. At dinner, Lisa reveals another benefit of her careful planning when she asks everyone to complete her liaison evaluation.

chapters.s: Lisa organizes a mock trial with a restaurant dinner as Voyager's reward. Muriel and Elisa agree to spar after Lisa offers help finding relics and stakes the Captain's sword.
Asherah and Luna defeat the saintesses, showing Voyager's improved strength. At the promised dinner, Lisa secures glowing liaison evaluations from the well-fed team.

stories.name: Dungeon Raiders
stories.label: Event story
stories.summary: Petra Construction discovers dangerous ancient ruins while rehearsing a groundbreaking ceremony. Fearing the discovery will ruin her largest contract, Petra enlists Voyager to hold off the constructs while her team gathers valuables. City officials confiscate the finds and halt the project, but a bounty on ancient constructs covers the company's losses. Petra promptly imagines a new business opportunity in hunting them.

chapters.s: Petra's groundbreaking rehearsal exposes ruins beneath the construction site. She calls in Voyager to fight ancient constructs while her crew tries to recover valuables before officials arrive.
Officials confiscate the recovered treasure and restrict construction, but a construct-hunting bounty covers Petra's costs. She quickly proposes turning the crew toward a new hunting venture.

stories.name: Wedding Wars: For the May Bride
stories.label: Event story
stories.summary: Frey brings Monastir's Mayflower Festival to NOA and asks the Captain to choose its ceremonial bride. A sensational newspaper story turns the event into a chaotic pursuit of the supposed groom. Carmen and Epindel protect the Captain while struggling to admit their own wishes. Their growing resolve carries them through rival contestants and an opportunistic arms dealer.

chapters.s: Frey invites the Captain to judge the May Bride at a festival in NOA. Carmen explains that the title is ceremonial and does not involve marriage.
Carmen escorts the Captain to rehearsal. Their conversation hints at wishes she has set aside while serving as Monastir's shield.
Epindel overhears talk of choosing a bride. A reporter interviews Omega and writes a sensational story that encourages the wrong conclusion.
Rumors turn the festival crowd into a wave of would-be brides. Frey cannot contain them, so Carmen takes the Captain toward the rooftop.
Carmen carries the Captain away from the crowd. Fei blocks their escape, convinced the Captain is seeking the strongest bride.
Carmen stays to fight Fei while the Captain escapes. After further chases and traps, Epindel arrives to rescue him.
The Captain declines Epindel's escape plan to keep a promise to Carmen. Epindel agrees to escort him across the rooftops toward the church.
Petra tries to lure the pair into an ambush. Her insults provoke Epindel into abandoning the safer rooftop route.
Epindel chases Petra into a bomb trap and hurts her ankle. Carmen arrives while the Captain is tending the injury.
An arms dealer sends a bridal combat automaton to seize the Captain. He hopes victory over famous Saviors will advertise his machines.
Epindel refuses to give up, inspiring Carmen to admit her own wish. The pair advance toward the church despite injuries and rival contestants.
Carmen and Epindel overcome their rivals and reach the church entrance. They prepare to confront the machine holding the Captain.
Carmen faces Fei again, now openly committed to competing. Fei welcomes a serious opponent.
Epindel tries to answer Petra's teasing with an awkward display of charm. Both prepare to fight in earnest.
Carmen and Epindel approach Kyra, who is muttering about her rivals. They decide not to wait for her to act.
The arms dealer finds Carmen and Epindel unwilling to back down. They join forces when he reactivates the automaton.
Carmen creates an opening for Epindel to strike the machine's weak point. They free the Captain just as the festival bell begins to ring.
The Captain names both Carmen and Epindel winners, inviting more teasing and another sensational headline. Omega confronts the reporter who started the rumors.

stories.name: Sonatine for the Forgotten
stories.label: Event story
stories.summary: A mysterious journal and sightings of doubles draw Claire and Bell into records of Carnelia’s time as Master Maid. Reliving those days reveals Claire’s rescue and Carnelia’s hidden suffering, as well as the bargain that led her to leave Candle Square. The real Carnelia helps them escape the journal while surrendering to NOA after damaging its Divine Barrier. Claire and Bell resolve to help her, and Alicia offers Carnelia a new request as another crisis approaches.

chapters.s: An uncatalogued black book appears in Candle Square’s library. Claire takes it into custody, senses something familiar and cannot open its pages.
Several maids report seeing their own doubles, all linked to the library or black book. Claire seeks help while Carnelia quietly approaches NOA’s Divine Barrier.
Roberta is called away by an emergency before examining the book. Bell recognizes Rhys magic on its seal, and opening it pulls her and Claire into a strange Candle Square.
Claire and Bell meet a version of Carnelia from Claire’s first month as a maid. Completing chores shifts them between scenes, suggesting this is not ordinary time travel.
Claire realizes the chores follow her early days at Candle Square. Watching Carnelia’s kindness prompts her to tell Bell how they first met.
Claire recalls leading the Blue Rose Sisterhood into danger. Carnelia and Candle Square’s maids rescue the injured riders from Voidborns and escort them to safety.
Claire explains how Carnelia’s rescue inspired her to become a maid. She and Bell find the journal inside the recreated world and turn to their last private meeting.
Claire relives tea with Carnelia and asks about her hidden pain. She and Bell resolve to follow the maid’s manual and guide Carnelia back rather than reject her.
Roberta arrests Carnelia near the Divine Barrier. Inside the journal, Claire and Bell witness the Witch of Favoritism offer Carnelia death and corrupt the Light of Dawn.
The recorded world collapses into a realm of lingering emotions, where the real Carnelia meets Claire and Bell. She reveals that she is in NOA awaiting Alicia.
Claire and Bell promise to help Carnelia in the real world. Carnelia warns that Dissonance in the journal has awakened a hostile remnant and joins them against it.
Claire, Bell and Carnelia defeat the remnant so the journal realm can end. Carnelia reflects that she left behind a hope that someone would stop her.
Claire recovers and receives the restored Light of Dawn, while Carnelia remains under Alicia’s supervision. Alicia offers Carnelia a new request as danger approaches from the west.

stories.name: Lost in Summer! Fated Paradise
stories.label: Event story
stories.summary: A seaside break leaves the Captain, Luna and Smile in debt after Luna loses her wallet. They accept a treasure hunt from Ayla, a sick girl seeking relief from a curse, despite Luna foreseeing failure and death. Stranded on Grave Island, they discover that the first treasure is only a clue, and an impossible second moon restores their resolve to challenge fate. They defeat pursuing pirates and find a blessed compass that frees Ayla, while Luna begins to believe in a future worth living again.

chapters.s: The Captain, Luna and Smile reach Flora ahead of the others and splurge on a beach holiday. Luna then discovers that her wallet disappeared during a shark scare.
Unable to recover Luna’s wallet or cover their bills, the trio searches for paid work. They rescue a frightened girl from pirates pursuing her treasure map.
Ayla explains that opening the Pirate King’s map left her cursed and that her parents vanished seeking a cure. Luna’s reading of her future leaves the oracle badly shaken.
Luna warns that Ayla’s quest is doomed, but Smile and the Captain still want to help. Ayla’s determination to live persuades Luna to join the treasure hunt.
A beach rest turns dangerous when a strange shark attacks and pursues the group onto land. After escaping, Luna realizes their day differed from the future she had foreseen.
An old sailor identifies Grave Island as the map’s destination and provides a boat. Before the group can leave, pirates corner them in a cave and seize Ayla’s map.
The group escapes with half the map, but pirate cannon fire damages their boat. Smile uses her weapon’s recoil for propulsion until violent currents overturn the vessel.
The survivors wash up on Grave Island without a way home. Despite exhaustion and Ayla’s worsening health, they find the marked stone and uncover coins with an old logbook.
Ayla’s parents’ log describes finding only ordinary coins, crushing her hope for a cure. Luna foresees Ayla’s death, but the Captain produces an impossible second moon.
Ayla gives up after overhearing Luna’s prediction. Luna shows her the two moons and renews their promise to defy fate, persuading Ayla to keep seeking a cure.
Luna notices that some treasure coins are unusually light. Throwing them into the sea creates a path toward the second moon and reveals a hidden ship.
The group searches the mysterious ship, but the pirates and their pet shark have followed them. Luna and Smile prepare to fight for the missing half of Ayla’s map.
After defeating the pirates, the group restores the map and finds a blessed compass. Its light lifts Ayla’s curse, and its needle points to Ayla herself as dawn arrives.
Back in Flora, Ayla plans to search for her parents and Luna chooses to embrace life again. Their beach break ends when Asherah and the recovered Omega arrive for training.

stories.name: Metabasis of Ashen Embers
stories.label: Event story
stories.summary: Cristelle and Haydee enlist the Captain to investigate ancient ruins for a lead on the Executor Morcerf. A stone tablet draws them into a kingdom recreated from Haydee’s lost memories, revealing that she was its princess. Morcerf’s remaining influence tries to make Haydee accept false guilt and Cristelle sacrifice her companion for revenge, but the Captain helps them reject that ending. A loyal guardian saves them from the collapsing illusion, and the pair returns to their hunt with renewed trust and offers the Voyager party support.

chapters.t: The Secret of the Ancient Ruins
chapters.s: Cristelle and Haydee return to the ruins where Haydee was found, using a tablet linked to Morcerf. Its reaction incapacitates them, and a moving statue forces their retreat.
Hubble brings the Captain to Cristelle and Haydee, who seek revenge against Morcerf. He accepts their request to help investigate the ruins without attracting her attention.
Cristelle and Haydee distract the guardian while the Captain carries the tablet to the gate. The statue briefly stops attacking, allowing all three to slip inside.
Beyond the gate, the trio finds the ancient kingdom alive and populated. They hear of a sick princess and a mysterious sage, the identity Morcerf once used.
Cristelle reveals that her corrupted eye can identify Morcerf’s Void signature. The group seeks access to the palace while wondering why nobody recognizes Haydee.
Cristelle bluffs and bribes the party into the palace as foreign envoys. The sage’s room is an empty black space, and a guard discovers them as Haydee becomes unwell.
The group flees through the palace using Haydee’s instincts, but she collapses amid memories of the garden. Officials recognize her as their princess and arrest her companions.
Cristelle concludes that the world may be built from Haydee’s memories and that Morcerf corrupted her. A red moon signals approaching ruin, and the statue frees them from prison.
Following the statue into the garden, the Captain and Cristelle find Haydee surrounded by bodies. Sensing Void power in her, they fight to bring her back.
Haydee believes she destroyed her kingdom and no longer deserves revenge. The Captain stops her from giving up, but Cristelle threatens to kill her to obtain Morcerf’s Void trace.
The Captain refuses to sacrifice Haydee and challenges what revenge would leave Cristelle with. Cristelle unleashes her cursed eye and demands that he stop her by force.
Haydee’s trust and the Captain’s promise make Cristelle reject sacrificing her companion. Cristelle instead shoots a hidden enemy, exposing Morcerf’s role in the scene.
Morcerf’s remnant reveals itself as the chamberlain. The Captain and Cristelle expose fabricated evidence against Haydee before Morcerf sends a brainwashed knight to stop their escape.
The trio cannot defeat the knight before the palace collapses. Haydee prepares to sacrifice herself so her companions can escape, while Cristelle struggles to stop her.
The guardian statue defeats the enemy and shields the trio from the collapse. They learn how Perses and the kingdom sacrificed themselves to save Haydee, then leave the ruins together.
Cristelle and Haydee sponsor the Voyager party before departing and warn that Morcerf may be in NOA. Elsewhere, a bored figure prepares a new scheme involving a fountain pen.

stories.name: A Study in Gray
stories.label: Event story
stories.summary: Lampadis Investigations accepts a request to investigate a death in the feared Baskerville family. Gwen and Lily become determined to help Rachel, a child caught in the household's research. Professor M guides the investigation while testing what her companions notice and whom they trust. A seemingly solved case conceals a darker truth, and the Professor's private motives remain unsettling.

chapters.s: A dying detective leaves an old rival the key to Baker Street. The apparent victor finds the long-awaited moment unexpectedly empty.
Gwen brings Lampadis a request to investigate the former Baskerville head's death. Professor M and Lily question why their agency was chosen.
The investigators learn of the family's forbidden chimera research. At the mansion, Jack's hostility and an injured girl deepen their suspicions.

chapters.t: Even When Nothing Good Ever Happens
chapters.s: Henry shows the investigators a cleared crime scene. They befriend Rachel, and Professor M detects signs of recent magical treatment on her skin.
Gwen prioritizes Rachel's safety over the original case. Visits to the orphanage and clinic uncover troubling connections and a gift from Rachel's friend.
Gwen and Lily openly investigate the black market to draw out Baskerville's watchers. Armed mercenaries take the bait.
Gwen and Lily defeat their attackers and force a researcher to help them obtain records. Henry questions Jack about the attack.
The team arranges another meeting with Rachel and returns her friend's doll. Her happiness briefly lifts their spirits, but her health is worsening.
Purchase records point toward forbidden experiments. Henry admits knowing about the research and asks the investigators to help stop Jack.
Henry creates a distraction while the investigators enter the laboratory. They find Rachel unconscious beside Jack and confront his automatons.
Jack escapes with Rachel after an exploding automaton blocks pursuit. His trail leads into the foggy wasteland.
Henry takes control of the institute and joins the search. Around a campfire, the group discusses the cost of exposing his family's crimes.
The search reaches a hidden laboratory filled with old battle debris. A large automaton blocks the investigators while Henry presses onward.
The team finds Jack dying and Rachel unconscious. Henry carries her away while Gwen and Lily collect evidence from the scene.
Henry publicly celebrates the case's resolution, but Gwen and Lily remain uneasy. Professor M urges them to question the story they want to believe.
Rachel's doll yields a hidden letter and medicine. Gwen and Lily hurry to the rooftop as Professor M confronts Henry about his lies.
Henry unleashes his creation against Professor M. Gwen and Lily arrive, determined to reach the child trapped within it.
The investigators use Jack's medicine and their combined skills to rescue Rachel. Henry's own creation brings his ambitions to an end.

chapters.t: The Investigator in a Street That Lost Its Detective
chapters.s: Jack's letter explains his attempt to save Rachel. Gwen offers her a place at Lampadis, while the team challenges the Professor's secretive methods.
Alone after the case, Professor M records disturbing observations about her companions. Her search for meaning is far from over.

stories.name: A Warrior's Heart: Meant to Serve!
stories.label: Event story
stories.summary: After reclaiming the West, Ceres struggles with memories of her sister. A dubious maid manual sends her and Lydia into volunteer work, with the Captain helping them find people to serve. Their clumsy efforts bring comedy and moments of connection, but cannot resolve what Ceres is avoiding. Lydia and the Captain help her face an old promise and accept support from those still beside her.

chapters.s: Lydia worries about Ceres' recurring dreams of Venera. Besta's dubious manual inspires Ceres to try serving the West as a maid.
The Captain arrives to find Ceres and Lydia in maid outfits. He agrees to help with volunteer work as a change from their usual duties.
The Captain gathers requests from residents. Lydia recalls how Ceres accepted her powers and promised they would share difficult burdens.
A mishap destroys a pottery workshop, but the search through its wreckage recovers a precious photograph. Ceres finds meaning in helping its owner.
More volunteer jobs go badly, leaving no willing clients. A misleading scene convinces nearby Liberators that their commanders need rescuing.
The Liberators confront the Captain over the maid outfits. Attempts to explain only worsen the misunderstanding until Lydia loses her temper.
Ceres settles the confrontation and praises her soldiers' care for one another. Her confident words about Venera leave her friends concerned.
Ceres' nightmares return, and she insists on more work. At a research lab, a Sunblossom recalls Venera and leaves her momentarily unable to act.
The group recaptures escaped slimes. Ceres admits that memories of Venera overwhelmed her, and the Captain asks Lydia for a private conversation.
The Captain urges Lydia to acknowledge her own distress. Together, they consider helping Ceres face memories she has been trying to erase.
Lydia reminds Ceres of their promise to share burdens. Ceres agrees to discuss the plans she once made with Venera.
Ceres recalls promising to see the West's flowers with her sister. The Captain and Lydia persuade her to visit the Moonlight Forest.
A Void Ravager suggests the forest cannot support ordinary life. With her companions beside her, Ceres chooses to continue the search.
The group discovers flowers blooming under moonlight. Ceres begins to speak openly about missing Venera and the future she still wants to share.

chapters.t: All Quiet on the Western Maid Front
chapters.s: Ceres continues volunteering with a lighter heart. She and Lydia can now talk and joke about Venera, while Besta hopes to join their next outing.

stories.name: The Exile's Return Trajectory
stories.label: Event story
stories.summary: Exiled from Lavistar, Gille survives by counting her orbits and revisiting the past. Memories of Aldebaran, Tyria and the Captain complicate the purpose she has always served. The Witch of Favoritism interrupts her waiting and points out a way to regain strength. Gille prepares to return with a sharper sense of her own will.

chapters.s: Weakened outside Lavistar, Gille remembers receiving her name and mission. Aldebaran's distant voice tells her to endure until the barrier falls.
Gille counts her orbits and recalls Tyria's interest in human life. Their old conversation unsettles her while the Void continues to wear her down.
Gille remembers imprisonment in Alicia's Cycle and the Captain's unexpected invitation to the Journey. His offer differs from her master's commands.
The Witch of Favoritism finds Gille still circling Lavistar. By striking nearby Voidborns, she shows Gille a way to recover her strength.
Gille feeds on Voidborns and begins counting toward her return. Her renewed mission now carries an insistence on choosing for herself.

stories.name: Asherah
stories.label: Voyager Savior Party
stories.summary: Asherah joins the Journey hoping to become a hero like the Star Savior she admired as a child. Her impatience leads her into danger, and the Captain helps her recover her confidence and learn to rely on others. Alicia's letter teaches her that perseverance mattered more than her hero's original strength. After passing the final trial, Asherah refuses to forget her missing Captain and sets out to find them.

chapters.s: Asherah meets the Captain and shares her childhood dream of becoming a Star Savior who protects others.
When poor meals weaken Asherah, the Captain teaches her simple recipes and cooks dinner at her quarters.
At the library, Asherah reveals her hope that the original Star Savior is alive and that she might meet him someday.
Asherah asks for more real combat, revealing her impatience with training and hints that she ran away from home.
Asherah takes a quest alone, falls into a Raider trap, and injures her ankle. The failure badly shakes her confidence.

chapters.t: If You Want to Go Far
chapters.s: Over dinner, Asherah explains her family's objections and her doubts. The Captain helps her see the value of moving forward together.
Asherah and the Captain enjoy the New Year festival and rocket launch. Her dream begins to change as their bond grows.
Alicia replies to the Captain's letter, explaining how the Star Savior grew through perseverance and support from others.
Before the final trial, Asherah thanks the Captain for changing her life and invites them to visit her hometown.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Asherah completes the Journey, but the Captain disappears and Lisa remembers no companion. Asherah leaves the celebration to search for them.

stories.name: Smile
stories.label: Voyager Savior Party
stories.summary: Smile, a self-described homunculus, joins the Journey to learn how to smile and help her missing sister become human. Her inventions lead to disastrous experiments until the Captain shifts their search toward companionship. Building a pair of robotic cats helps Smile discover that caring about someone can bring real happiness. After the final trial, she remembers the vanished Captain and sets out to find the person who matters to her.

chapters.s: Smile tests the Captain with a lie detector and explains that she joined the Journey to learn how to smile.
Smile's first potion experiment leaves the Captain laughing uncontrollably for a week.
Smile reveals her wish to help her missing sister become human. Her next experiment traps the Captain in a runaway tickling machine.
The Captain takes Smile to a cafe, theater, and park to find something she enjoys. A girl with a cat catches her attention.
After they fail to catch a cat, the Captain makes Smile a stuffed one as a gift.
Smile gives the stuffed cat a mechanical body, but its built-in weapon fires on them and destroys the Captain's room.
During the New Year festival, they find the escaped robot cat watching kittens. The Captain suggests making it a companion.
Seeing two robot cats become friends brings out Smile's first smile. She and the Captain plan to search for her sister together.
Before the final trial, Smile says a photo of someone important helped confirm the Captain's idea about happiness.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: After completing the Journey, Smile realizes the Captain has vanished. She starts searching for the person she cares about.

stories.name: Luna
stories.label: Voyager Savior Party
stories.summary: Luna joins the Journey while buried in gambling debts and draws the Captain into her financial troubles. Her accurate prophecies have convinced her that effort cannot change fate, but the Captain keeps trying to show her a worthwhile future. Failed jobs lead to unexpected good outcomes, and a shared gamble helps her rediscover hope. After the final trial, Luna resolves to meet the vanished Captain again, even though she cannot foresee their reunion.

chapters.s: Luna arrives fleeing creditors and persuades the Captain to guarantee debts she built up through gambling.
The Captain finds Luna gambling instead of training. Her attempts to read the Captain's blurry future end in mishaps.
Finding Luna sleeping outdoors, the Captain gets her clean and fed, then learns she has already borrowed against the Journey reward.
A creditor reveals that Luna once helped save his mother. The Captain negotiates more time and decides Luna needs honest work.
Luna's fortune-telling stall succeeds, but its unlicensed earnings are seized. She says her prophecies show a future that cannot change.
Monster hunting, weeding, and mail delivery all go wrong. Luna takes the repeated setbacks as proof that honest effort is pointless.
The Captain discovers good outcomes behind their failed jobs and wins a gamble that pays part of Luna's debt, giving her fresh hope.
Luna recalls seeing the world's end. After another gambling loss, she and the Captain work as cleaners, and she buys them a simple meal.
Luna recalls her master's prophecy about someone who could create a future beyond the end. Before the trial, she asks the Captain's name.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Luna passes the final trial and credits the Captain for her renewed hope. When they vanish, she vows to meet them again.

stories.name: Carnelia
stories.label: Wanderer
stories.summary: The Captain meets Carnelia after missing records delay their introduction, and discovers that her return has upset the maids she once led. She gradually reveals that an inherited immortality curse has left her unable to enjoy the ordinary life she longs for. Shared gardening, tea, and a quiet festival night give her reasons to reconsider the death she hoped the Journey would grant. At the end, she feels the curse may be broken and begins to imagine a future while the Captain fades away.

chapters.s: With her records missing, the Captain searches NOA until Carnelia finds them and quietly introduces herself as their Journey member.
Carnelia's return to Candle Square angers her sister Bell. Claire agrees to receive her as a Journey member rather than the former Master Maid.
The Captain discovers Carnelia preparing training equipment alone before dawn. Claire supports her work, and the Captain offers to help.
While showing the garden, Carnelia hints that she left Candle Square seeking something and has no plans for after the Journey.
Over tea, Carnelia reveals her immortality curse and the emptiness she feels despite her achievements as Master Maid.
Gardening together brings Carnelia genuine laughter. She admits she joined the Journey hoping to die, but now feels uncertain.
The Captain falls ill before their festival outing. Carnelia stays to care for them and creates a starry ceiling for them to watch together.

chapters.t: The Double Bar and the Repeat
chapters.s: As the final trial approaches, the Captain encourages Carnelia to imagine things she might want to do after her curse is broken.
Carnelia and the Captain prepare to enter the final trial without Lisa. They promise that their shared moments will remain in starlight.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Carnelia feels her curse may be lifted as the Captain fades. Though their face slips from memory, she begins looking forward to flowers and festivals.

stories.name: Bell
stories.label: Candle Square
stories.summary: Bell begins the Journey with a sharp tongue and little interest in strenuous training, but an old family oath forces her to obey the Captain. Her schemes to escape the oath fail, while their time together reveals the care behind her gravekeeping duties. She gradually changes how she treats others and learns to trust the Captain's promise of freedom. When the Captain vanishes before speaking the words that would release her, Bell sets out to demand their return.

chapters.s: Bell's rude introduction ends when the Captain invokes her family's obedience oath and makes her take training seriously.

chapters.t: Never Heard It from My Father
chapters.s: Bell searches her family archives and discovers that the Captain can free her from the oath by expressing trust in her.
Bell tries to drug and possess the Captain to obtain the release phrase, but a mistaken ingredient turns her scheme into a painful failure.
At the cemetery, Bell explains her pride in giving every grave equal care. The Captain better understands her unusual views on death.
Bell tries to win the Captain's trust by acting like an eager student, but finds her forced politeness unbearable.
Bell reveals why she wants the Captain's trust. The Captain promises to break the oath after the Journey and asks her to trust them too.
Helping Bell move a treasured stone leads to a talk about her duties. She says she will continue the Journey and trust the Captain's promise.
Bell becomes more considerate through an unusual change in perspective. She tells the Captain she trusts them as the final trial approaches.
Before the final trial, Bell reminds the Captain of their promise to release her and openly declares her trust.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Bell completes the Journey, but the Captain vanishes before breaking her oath. She rushes off to find them and hear the promised words.

stories.name: Emily
stories.label: Candle Square
stories.summary: Emily mistakes the Captain for a new maid, beginning a Journey marked by her cleaning obsession and severe forgetfulness. The Captain learns that her supposed covert assignment was invented to move a gifted but battle-focused mercenary away from the front. When Emily overhears the truth and fears becoming a monster, the Captain reassures her and helps her choose her own future at Candle Square. She completes the trial, then holds onto her memories of the Captain after they disappear.

chapters.s: Emily mistakes the Captain for a rookie maid and leads them through a demanding cleaning lesson before Claire clears up the confusion.
Emily misses training because of her forgetfulness. She describes her mercenary past but avoids explaining why she left.
Emily recruits the Captain into her supposed secret investigation. Claire reveals the mission was invented to give Emily a break from combat.
Emily fights with flawless awareness but forgets her sword and supplies afterward. The contrast worries the Captain.
Emily's memory briefly improves after combat. Trying to recall the change overwhelms her, so Claire seeks answers from her old commander.
Hiding in Claire's room, Emily overhears that her mission is false and that her commander feared her growing dependence on combat.
Emily fears becoming a monster and considers quitting. The Captain points to her kindness and gives her a new mission: finish the Journey.
Emily uses detailed notes to manage her memory and accepts her combat talent, though forgotten chores show the method still has limits.
Emily prepares for the final trial, determined to use her fighting gifts for a worthwhile purpose.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Emily completes the trial and chooses life as a maid. When the Captain disappears, she trusts her vivid memories and hopes to meet them again.

stories.name: Charlotte
stories.label: Monastir Knights
stories.summary: Charlotte joins the Journey while struggling to feel worthy of her new position as Monastir's Grand Master. Her extraordinary endurance contrasts with her insecurity about noble manners and formal speech. The Captain helps her see that protecting people matters more than appearances, and a rescue during the New Year festival proves her strength as a leader. After the final trial, she searches for the vanished Captain so she can thank them and show her continued growth.

chapters.s: Charlotte nervously introduces herself as Monastir's new Grand Master. The Captain encourages her to relax during training.
Charlotte asks for harder training and recovers from an exhausting session far faster than the Captain.

chapters.t: My Origins May Not Be Much!
chapters.s: Charlotte explains that her humble background leaves her unsure she deserves to lead the knights despite her strong combat skills.
Letters from Monastir strengthen Charlotte's resolve to complete the Journey and protect her homeland from monsters.
Charlotte strains to act dignified in town. The Captain takes her to a lively restaurant where she can finally relax and enjoy her food.

chapters.t: How About Saying It like This?
chapters.s: Speech practice leaves Charlotte discouraged. The Captain explains that a leader's real strength is standing firm to protect others.
A festival fire traps a mother and child. Charlotte holds up a collapsing ceiling until rescue arrives, discovering what her leadership means.
Charlotte visits the people she rescued and receives public praise. She thanks the crowd in her own voice rather than forcing formal manners.
Encouraged by the townspeople, Charlotte enters the final trial confident that she can grow into a leader who stands beside others.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Charlotte completes the Journey and thanks the Captain, then searches for them after they vanish without letting her repay their kindness.

stories.name: Carmen
stories.label: Monastir Knights
stories.summary: Carmen enters the Journey hoping to bring useful experience back to the Monastir Knights. Behind her teasing composure, she secretly pushes herself through extra training because she fears failing those she protects. The Captain helps her acknowledge her exhaustion and accept support without giving up her resolve. After completing the final trial, she puts celebration aside to search for the vanished person she wants to protect.

chapters.s: Carmen introduces herself as Monastir's Deputy Master and hopes the Journey will help her support the knights back home.
Carmen shows the strength needed to wield her heavy shield, then teaches the Captain a demanding stretching routine.
The Captain brings Carmen a coveted tart and notices fresh wounds that do not fit her story about an evening stroll.
The Captain finds Carmen secretly training at night and joins her after trying her powerful but unpleasant recovery broth.
Sharing mead, Carmen explains a Monastir custom that honors comrades and strengthens the promise to protect one another.
Carmen's exhaustion catches up with her. The Captain challenges the calm mask hiding her anxiety, and she agrees to rest.
Carmen chooses a quiet festival evening with the Captain over more training and admits how much she wants to protect peaceful days.
Carmen thanks the Captain with homemade food whose healing effects are much better than its taste.
Before the final trial, Carmen says she wants to stay with the Savior Party longer to travel and keep learning beside the Captain.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Carmen finishes the Journey ready to accept help. When the Captain vanishes, she postpones the celebration to find the person she wants to protect.

stories.name: Frey
stories.label: Monastir Knights
stories.summary: Frey arrives with ambitious business schemes and hopes the Captain's connections will make her rich. After scams and failed pitches, she reveals that her real goal is to fund a safer and more prosperous Monastir. The Captain encourages a smaller start, and her honey candy business gives her a practical way to help her people. Having completed the Journey, she searches for the vanished Captain whom she wants beside her and still owes a debt.

chapters.s: Frey introduces herself through an ambitious Savior investment scheme and demands access to the Captain's supposed powerful connections.
Frey buys fake heating mats for a sales venture. After the Captain exposes the scam, she angrily sets out to confront the sellers.
Frey nearly recruits Lisa into a pyramid scheme until the Captain's questions expose its impossible numbers.
Discouraged by failed business ideas, Frey considers quitting. The prospect of earning a Savior's fame renews her commitment to the Journey.

chapters.t: The Reason I Want to Be Rich
chapters.s: Frey explains that she wants wealth to protect Monastir from disaster and poverty. The Captain suggests starting with a small business.
Frey's honey candy succeeds through good ingredients, storytelling, and real donations, though she insists her methods are underhanded.
Charlotte pursues Frey for taking the knights' reserve funds to expand her candy business, sending her fleeing to the Captain.
Frey skips meals after her allowance is cut and her profits go to disaster aid. The Captain offers food while she promises repayment.
Before the final trial, Frey thanks the Captain and offers them a future role in Monastir when she takes the throne.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Frey completes the Journey, but the Captain disappears. She cancels the celebration to find the person she needs and repay her debt.

stories.name: Seira
stories.label: Nightmare
stories.summary: Seira joins the Journey hoping to control her dream-feeding power and live among people without harming them. The Captain enjoys her soothing dreams until her growing strength begins trapping NOA in sleep. After a dream-obsessed hunter destroys her restraining butterfly, Seira absorbs the nightmares and saves everyone. Greater strength still cannot give her the ordinary life she wanted, but she leaves with a new purpose: finding the Captain again in dreams.

chapters.s: The Captain encounters Seira in a dream before meeting her at Candle Square, feeling unusually rested yet unable to recall their first exchange.
Seira gently ends the Captain's nightmare, but their memory of her nighttime visit fades by morning.
Rumors about dream-feeding succubi unsettle the Captain. Seira soothes them to sleep during a nighttime walk.
Seira says she wants enough power to live among people. After she comforts a child, a self-proclaimed succubus hunter questions the Captain.
Seira's training progresses, but the Captain and nearby maids become increasingly sleepy and struggle to wake.
Seira admits her uncontrolled dream domain can trap people asleep and considers leaving. The Captain promises support if she chooses to continue.
With NOA asleep, a hunter seeking eternal dreams destroys Seira's butterfly. Seira later wakes the Captain and the city.
Seira explains how she absorbed the nightmares and received a replacement butterfly from Alicia. The Captain comforts her as she faces leaving NOA.
Before the final trial, Seira asks permission to visit the Captain's dreams afterward and watch over their rest.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Seira completes the Journey but cannot contain her stronger dream power. She must leave NOA and resolves to find the vanished Captain in dreams.

stories.name: Trish
stories.label: Aselus Association
stories.summary: Trish is a talented hunter who spends lavishly and risks herself to look impressive. Her childhood poverty and the flood that destroyed her home have made her distrust saving anything for tomorrow. The Captain challenges her reckless habits, while a visit to a thriving orchard from her past shows her that patient effort can still bear fruit. After finishing the Journey, Trish realizes that hunting and spending alone no longer feel satisfying, and pursues her missing Captain.

chapters.s: Trish meets the Captain after collecting a bounty, then offers an extravagant meal she cannot afford without borrowing from them.
Trish repays the Captain but defends her lavish spending. The Captain worries that she keeps using up each bounty as soon as she earns it.
A flashy training stunt breaks Trish's costly dagger. The Captain requires a spending ledger before lending repair money and gets her to stop using credit.
Trish takes the Captain on a luxury shopping and spa trip to prove that spending freely makes life enjoyable.

chapters.t: Live for Style, Die for Style
chapters.s: After a stunt nearly sends her over a cliff, Trish explains how childhood poverty and a devastating flood shaped her pursuit of a flashy life.
The Captain uses Trish's own hunter principles to stop her taking stolen loot and breaking her promise about buying on credit.
Morian berries remind Trish of planting fruit with her father before the flood. She dismisses the old hope and buys far more than she can eat.
Trish discovers that Morian trees survived the flood and now support children. She begins to value leaving something for the future and helps in secret.
Before the final trial, Trish admits she will miss the Captain's company and promises another big hunt together.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Trish completes the trial, then notices the Captain's absence. Enjoying her success alone feels wrong, so she vows to track them down.

stories.name: Lyn
stories.label: Wind Moon Sect
stories.summary: Lyn joins the Journey to build a better future for children, bringing the warmth of a teacher and a hidden role in Nature's Grace. Her attempts to conceal covert missions repeatedly harm the Captain's memory until she finally shares the truth and earns their acceptance. A trafficking rescue leaves her doubting herself, but a child's gratitude restores her resolve. After completing the Journey, she turns her pursuit from criminals to the missing Captain who accepted every part of her.
