chapters.s: Lyn introduces herself as a Wind Moon Sect children's instructor and explains that she joined the Journey for the next generation.
Lyn and the Captain volunteer at a daycare. She comforts an abandoned girl and reveals that the Sect Master raised her after she was left as a baby.
The Captain witnesses Lyn capturing criminals as a secret Nature's Grace operative. She erases their memory to protect her identity.
Repeated memory erasures leave the Captain confused. Lyn finally explains her covert work, and the Captain accepts her choice and offers support.
After a joint capture, Lyn cares for the Captain's cold with medicinal cooking. An explicit flyer in their pocket leaves her flustered.
Lyn and the Captain rescue trafficking victims, including the daycare girl. Lyn loses her temper at the captor and fears she has frightened the children.
Lyn doubts the value of her work until the rescued girl thanks her and says she wants to become an adult like her.
Lyn joins the Captain in returning a lost boy to his parents. Caring for him brings them closer and prompts talk of a future family.
Before the final trial, Lyn thanks the Captain for helping her accept herself and continue working for children and the future.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Lyn completes the Journey but senses the Captain has disappeared. She postpones the celebration and sets out to find someone dear to her.

stories.name: Cristelle
stories.label: Morrel Ocean Traders
stories.summary: Cristelle, the wealthy president of Morrel Ocean Traders, seeks the Star Savior's power to take revenge on Morcerf. Betrayal, cruel experiments, and a cursed eye have left her treating both her company and her life as disposable tools. The Captain helps her recognize that her bonds with Haydee and her employees are real, giving her reasons to keep living after revenge. When the Captain vanishes at the end of the Journey, finding the person she wants to return to becomes her first priority.

chapters.s: Cristelle greets the Captain with extravagant gifts and says she seeks overwhelming power, though her cheerful manner hides a deeper purpose.
Haydee visits with a painting that mirrors Cristelle's fixation on darkness. She asks the Captain to look after the president.
The Captain discovers Cristelle is dissolving her company. She reveals the childhood betrayal and experiments behind her revenge against Morcerf.
Cristelle shows the Captain the nightmares inflicted by her cursed eye and admits she plans to disappear after achieving revenge.
Despite Cristelle's resistance, the Captain insists her life holds more than revenge and offers to help her find something worth returning to.
Seeing Cristelle care for her employees, the Captain challenges her claim that the company is merely a tool. She starts recognizing the bonds she built.
Cristelle cancels the company's dissolution and hosts a New Year party. She decides to preserve her relationships while still pursuing revenge.
The Captain cooks stew for an overworked Cristelle. In return, they ask her to make them a meal after the Journey.
Before the final trial, Cristelle says thoughts of loved ones now help her face the cursed eye's nightmares.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Cristelle completes the Journey and realizes the Captain is the person she wants to return to. Their disappearance sends her searching for them.

stories.name: Haydee
stories.label: Morrel Ocean Traders
stories.summary: Haydee treats the Journey as cover for hunting Morcerf, the enemy tied to the destruction of her forgotten homeland. She resists the Captain's efforts to get close, but gradually reveals the loneliness beneath her cold manner. Train rides, gardening, and an unexpected return to ancient ruins help her discover feelings and memories beyond revenge. After the final trial takes the Captain from her side, she refuses to accept another precious loss and begins searching.

chapters.s: Haydee introduces herself as Morrel's vice president but rejects friendship, saying the Journey is only a useful public excuse.
Haydee asks about several names linked to an enemy and warns the Captain away. Cristelle later suggests flowers as a way to reach her.
The Captain gives Haydee anemones, but their claim to understand her touches a painful nerve and she rejects the attempt at friendship.

chapters.t: What Does the Thorned Flower Seek?
chapters.s: After the Captain saves Haydee from an attacker, she reveals Morrel's intelligence network and her revenge against the enemy who destroyed her kingdom.
A prototype train ride draws out Haydee's interest. The Captain shares their own memory loss and offers companionship without claiming to know her pain.

chapters.t: Things You Can't See Until You Try
chapters.s: Haydee reluctantly grows a flower from seed and finds joy in its bloom. She agrees to join the Captain at the New Year festival.
Haydee enjoys festival games and fireworks with the Captain, though she struggles to admit how much the outing means to her.

chapters.t: Flowers Bloom Even in an Abandoned Garden
chapters.s: A surprise train trip brings Haydee back to her kingdom's ruins. A field of anemones stirs a faint memory of happiness.
Before the final trial, Haydee says she still seeks revenge but agrees to spend time exploring life with the Captain afterward.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Haydee completes the Journey and considers treating the Captain, then discovers their absence. Refusing another loss, she sets out to find them.

stories.name: Serpang
stories.label: Wind Moon Sect
stories.summary: Serpang would rather nap and snack than train, but her bird partner Toto accepts the Journey invitation on her behalf. The Captain discovers that her weak health and past isolation hide a strong bond with Toto, a young phoenix who dreams of protecting others. With patience, encouragement, and plenty of desserts, the pair become more willing to help people and face the trials. After succeeding, Serpang and Toto set off to find the vanished Captain and honor the kindness they received.

chapters.s: Sleepy Serpang introduces her partner Toto and admits that he accepted the Journey invitation while she was napping.
The Captain discovers that a free dessert coupon motivates Serpang and Toto to set a new training record.
Serpang explains her unusual ability to understand Toto, though she doubts his claim to be a phoenix and keeps avoiding training.
Serpang enlists the Captain to help make perfect pillows. Toto's feathers provide the final touch that sends her straight to sleep.
Serpang fears Toto has left her, but he returns with snacks from a part-time job. His story inspires her to help fulfill their shared Savior dream.

chapters.t: Serpang, the Missing, and the Guardian
chapters.s: Serpang and Toto spend the day comforting a lost girl until her mother arrives, showing the Captain how much they have grown.
The Captain hosts a New Year meal and board game night. Serpang and Toto win a dessert prize through their unusual game tactics.
Serpang makes commemorative pillows for all three of them, using the Captain's robe when shops run out of cotton.
Before the final trial, Serpang resolves to break out of her shell and promises to repay the Captain's kindness with future treats.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Serpang and Toto complete the Journey, but the Captain disappears. They postpone the celebration to search for the person who helped them grow.

stories.name: Gille
stories.label: Executor
stories.summary: Freed from the broken Cycle and much of her power, Gille reluctantly accepts the Captain's offer to join the Journey. A small flower gives her something to care for beyond her old mission. Harassment threatens that fragile attachment and forces her to confront loss. With the Captain beside her, she begins to consider a future she can choose for herself.

chapters.s: After Alicia releases her, a weakened Gille faces a hostile crowd. The Captain offers her safety and a way to regain strength through the Journey.
Gille isolates herself and distrusts the Captain's help. Training exposes her weakness, prompting a conversation about finding a present goal.
The Captain gives Gille a small flower. Despite dismissing the gift, she brings it inside and begins learning how to care for it.
Gille agrees to daytime training and tries befriending a cat. Alone afterward, she reveals that her meals have been deliberately spoiled.
A friendly florist treats Gille without fear. She buys gardening supplies and borrows books to learn more about raising her flower.
Harassment spreads to Gille's equipment and room. She suspects a maid but resists asking the Captain to intervene.
Gille finds her flower destroyed and nearly attacks the suspected bully. The Captain stops the violence and helps gather what remains.
Claire addresses the harassment. Gille reflects on loss, and the Captain offers seeds as a chance to begin caring for something again.
At the final trial, Gille faces a projection of her old self. She chooses a future with difficult feelings over returning to empty obedience.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Gille completes the Journey and parts from the Captain. She keeps the seeds and begins preparing to grow new flowers while she waits.

stories.name: Dana
stories.label: Canopus Rangers
stories.summary: Dana arrives from the Canopus Mountains eager to make people smile. The city overwhelms her at first, but she keeps helping anyone in need. Comparing her simple wish with another Savior's grand plans makes her doubt her place in the Journey. The kindness she has shared returns through the people around her, helping her recover confidence.

chapters.s: The Captain meets Dana while she rescues a cat. She explains that sharing kindness and seeing people smile inspired her to join the Journey.

chapters.t: A Country Girl in the Big City
chapters.s: Dana struggles with city crowds, shops and unfamiliar customs. The Captain holds her hand to keep them together while exploring NOA.
Dana notices the Captain is ill and cares for him with food, a strong village tea and a lullaby. By the next day, he feels well again.
The Captain sees Dana helping children, a baker and an elderly woman. She explains how her village taught her to pass kindness onward.
Another Savior describes ambitious plans for peace. Dana begins to wonder whether her wish to make people smile is enough to deserve the Journey.
The Captain gathers people Dana has helped to give her a happy day. Their gratitude reminds her that her kindness already matters.
Dana and the Captain help others before enjoying the New Year festival. This time, she catches his hand when the crowd threatens to separate them.
Dana invites the Captain camping to make memories before the Journey ends. They gather food and share a peaceful evening beneath the stars.
Before the final trial, Dana reflects on the kindness connecting her village, the Captain and herself. She wants to return it by completing the Journey.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Dana passes the trial and delights in the Captain's smile. When he disappears, she resolves to find him and return the kindness she received.

stories.name: Muriel
stories.label: Monolith Order
stories.summary: Muriel hopes the Journey will help her rise through the Monolith Order, although she badly misunderstands its dangers. Her schemes to claim the Star Piercer repeatedly backfire. The Captain tries to turn her sincere but self-serving faith into courage, with unpredictable results. Beneath the boasting, Muriel gradually learns to face danger with someone beside her.

chapters.s: Muriel tries to recruit the Captain through a misleading survey before learning who he is. Her ambition is to become the next High Saintess.

chapters.t: I Want to Be the High Saintess
chapters.s: Muriel tries to take the Star Piercer to improve her standing. Learning the Journey involves real danger leaves her terrified but unwilling to quit.
The Captain takes Muriel to a haunted house for courage training. Her attempt to frighten him ends with her fainting at a costumed worker.
Muriel recruits followers at a pyramid-scheme seminar, attracting angry criminals. Her oversized fire spell drives them off but burns her paperwork.
Muriel sneaks in to steal the Star Piercer. The Captain's disguised scolding convinces her she has received a divine revelation.
Muriel boasts that divine favor makes her invincible. A falling live wire shocks her, leaving her convinced she has been punished.
At a charity event, Muriel confesses her arrogance. The Captain again imitates a divine voice to encourage her to complete the Journey faithfully.
A forest assignment tests Muriel against a large slime. With the Captain's help she fights back, though her uncontrolled spell burns the forest.
Muriel panics before the final trial and begs to escape. Lisa starts the projection while the Captain tries to keep her focused.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Muriel passes and celebrates her imagined promotion. When the Captain disappears, she insists on finding him to deliver another scolding.

stories.name: Elisa
stories.label: Monolith Order
stories.summary: Elisa joins the Journey believing she has little worth and that higher-ranked clergy must know better. The Captain discovers her physical strength and talent for studying ancient relics. When careless advice threatens a restoration, she must learn to defend her own conclusions. Her growing confidence turns the Journey into a chance to trust both her abilities and her feelings.

chapters.s: Elisa arrives in armor because Muriel has frightened her about men. The Captain discovers a timid saintess whose fears run far ahead of reality.
Training reveals Elisa's poor coordination but also her considerable strength. She hopes to repay the Order that raised her, rather than pursue her own wish.
Elisa reconstructs a relic logically, then abandons her findings for senior clergy's guesses. The Captain sees that deference is undermining her expertise.
The Captain praises Elisa's real strengths to build confidence. Confused by her growing attachment, she accepts Illene's claim that he may be a demon.
Elisa attempts an exorcism on the Captain. When it fails, she recognizes how easily she was misled and resolves to change.
The Order plans to restore the relic according to the wrong theory. Elisa decides to gather evidence and argue for its true purpose.
With the ceremony moved forward and her script missing, Elisa must speak for herself. Her frustration finally breaks through the clergy's dismissals.
Elisa fears punishment, but the High Saintess accepts the value of her challenge. She is asked to use a gentler approach next time.
Elisa approaches the final trial knowing she can be right even when others disagree. She wants to prove her thoughts and efforts have value.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Passing the trial brings Elisa relief and pride. When Lisa denies the Captain was present, Elisa trusts her own memory and goes to find him.

stories.name: Tyria
stories.label: Executor
stories.summary: Tyria reluctantly joins the Journey and resents both NOA and the Captain. The city's barrier suppresses her power, while familiar Monastir food helps ease her homesickness. Shared meals and an unexpected day running a restaurant reveal a gentler future she might want. By the final trial, the life she has found matters more than the revenge she once imagined.

chapters.s: The Captain rides out to find a missing recruit and meets Tyria at the Monastir border. She recognizes him but reluctantly introduces herself.
Arguments over training expose Tyria's identity as an Executor. NOA's barrier weakens her, explaining why her performance differs from their first meeting.
Tyria becomes ill and refuses ordinary meals. Familiar Monastir soup helps her recover, revealing how deeply she misses home.
Tyria corrects the Captain's confused cafe order and introduces proper Monastir pairings. Shared visits become something she actively looks forward to.
Tyria and the Captain run a restaurant while its owner visits his injured son. Comforting a homesick customer inspires Tyria to imagine opening her own shop.

chapters.t: How to Calm a Child Throwing a Tantrum
chapters.s: With her favorite shops closed, Tyria grows frustrated. The Captain promises a Monastir trip in return for serious training, and she eagerly improves.
Monsters cancel their planned train trip. The pair ride to the border and fight together, then catch NOA's fireworks on their return.
Overlooking NOA, Tyria reflects on how old hatred has faded. She admits the city now holds places and memories she has grown to like.
The final trial reunites Tyria with a projection of Gille. She rejects the demand to return to her former duty and prepares to fight.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Tyria completes the Journey with revenge no longer her goal. She plans to help Monastir and open a small shop, wishing the departing Captain well.

stories.name: Roberta
stories.label: Orbital Search Team
stories.summary: Roberta joins the Journey while continuing to protect civilians as an Orbital Search Team leader. Repeated errors in disaster forecasts lead her to uncover manipulated data benefiting a mining company, despite retaliation from the Observation Director. With the Captain’s support, she evacuates a collapsing worksite and regains her position, learning how much her team values her. Her bond with the Captain grows, and after the final trial she refuses to accept that he has simply vanished.

chapters.s: Roberta’s first meeting with the Captain turns into an emergency when a prisoner’s device attracts monsters. Her improvised train-car barricade saves civilians but brings costly consequences.
Over late-night food and drinks, Roberta explains why protecting lives comes before rigid procedure. She and the Captain agree to meet like this again.
Lugh is injured after a supposedly low-risk assignment turns dangerous. Roberta questions repeated forecasting errors, but Observation Director Eleanor dismisses her concerns.
Roberta struggles to prove the forecasts are wrong while overworked and angry. A late-night conversation lets her share the burden with the Captain.
Roberta worries about what she said while drinking and becomes distracted around the Captain. His reassurance helps her recover her focus, though her growing feelings remain awkward.

chapters.t: The Price of Speaking the Truth
chapters.s: A monster attractor links suspicious risk forecasts to Astra Energy. Roberta confronts Eleanor about manipulation benefiting her son’s company and is suspended without sufficient proof.
Roberta and the Captain evacuate Astra Energy before its site collapses, proving the danger. Eleanor is arrested, and Roberta’s suspension and team reassignment are revoked.
Roberta celebrates with the Captain and nearly confesses her feelings. Her team interrupts with a surprise promotion-anniversary party, showing how deeply they appreciate her.
Before the final trial, Roberta thanks the Captain for their year together and invites him to keep visiting. She prepares to face the projected Gille without bureaucratic distractions.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Roberta clears the final trial and plans a private celebration with the Captain. When he disappears and Lisa remembers nobody else, Roberta insists she will find him.

stories.name: Lugh
stories.label: Orbital Search Team
stories.summary: Lugh’s inability to feel pain has left her isolated and dangerously careless with her own injuries. The Captain discovers her love of Stellar Rangers and helps her find purpose outside endless work. During a terrorist attack at a show, she becomes a masked hero and recognizes her wish to protect people as the reason she chose both Polaris and the Journey. After the final trial, she resolves to track down the missing Captain rather than forget what he changed in her life.

chapters.s: Lugh mistakes the Captain for a suspect before a hostage crisis interrupts their meeting. She rescues Naru with a dangerous distraction and reveals that she cannot feel pain.
During field training, Lugh stops monsters but disregards her own safety. The Captain reminds her that being unable to feel pain does not mean she cannot be hurt.
Lugh saves two civilians from a runaway terrorist vehicle, injuring herself again. Their frightened reaction revives memories of people calling her strange as a child.
The Captain meets Lugh at a Stellar Rangers performance and promises to keep her hobby private. Over coffee, she opens up about why the heroes fascinate her.
Roberta puts Lugh on leave so she can stop overworking and focus on the Journey. Without her usual duties, Lugh feels aimless and struggles to decide how to rest.
Lugh fills her free time by serving the Captain, but her protection becomes excessive. He encourages her to discover what draws her to the Journey and Stellar Rangers.
Terrorists seize a Stellar Rangers event. Disguised as Ranger Black, Lugh protects the audience and absorbs a bomb’s blast, then receives cheers instead of fear.
Lugh rents a theater to thank the Captain and share a favorite film. She realizes that admiration for heroes—and the wish to become one—gave her work and Journey meaning.
Before the final trial, Lugh affirms that she wants to continue helping people as an Observer. She also leaves open the possibility of someday serving beside the Captain.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Lugh clears the final trial and invites the Captain to a film marathon. When he vanishes, her changed fighting habits prove his influence, and she prepares to track him.

stories.name: Fei
stories.label: Wanderer
stories.summary: Fei comes to NOA to restore the lost Celestial Art after stealing its manuscript from the Wind Moon Sect. The Captain supports her dream through disastrous training and awkward efforts to win followers, helping her find a home in the West. Believing his words and movements make him her destined partner, she proposes marriage and plans a dojo. She completes the Journey determined to find the vanished Captain and receive the answer he still owes her.

chapters.s: The Captain meets Fei disciplining thugs who insulted the Celestial Art. She introduces her dream of reviving the lost style and immediately wants him to learn it.

chapters.t: Preach the Greatness of the Celestial Sect!
chapters.s: Fei’s street promotion goes badly until she rescues a boy from thieves. His new interest in the Celestial Art gives her a first hopeful recruit.
Fei attempts dangerous fasting and fishing as training, then collapses after catching a boulder. The Captain brings her back to NOA and pays for a huge recovery meal.
Fei explains that she stole the Celestial Manuscript from the master who raised her. The Captain’s encouragement unexpectedly echoes its teachings and renews her resolve.
Fei studies the Captain’s words and movements, seeing principles from her manuscript in them. She concludes that the heavens have sent him as her destined other half.
Fei abruptly proposes marriage, convinced the Captain is her partner in restoring the Celestial Art. After her persistent pursuit, they postpone discussing it until the Journey ends.
The Captain takes Fei to the New Year’s festival, then to their quiet playground. Fireworks answer her appeal to the heavens in an unexpected, joyful way.
Fei’s street promotions draw growing interest in a future dojo. She tells the Captain that his belief in her dream has made NOA feel like home.
Before the final trial, Fei plans to seek funding for a dojo at the playground. She reminds the Captain that she expects an answer to her proposal once they finish.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Fei clears the final trial and looks ahead to her dojo and reconciliation with her old sect. When the Captain vanishes, she sets out to find her missing partner.

stories.name: Epindel
stories.label: House Orlan
stories.summary: Epindel joins the Journey to secure her place as House Orlan’s heir and initially insists on controlling her own training. Her perfect noble image conceals fears and loneliness that the Captain gradually discovers. A rematch teaches her that exposing a weakness to someone trustworthy can lead to growth, and she learns to share burdens despite family pressure. After passing the final trial, she refuses to let the missing Captain escape the trust and affection she has given him.

chapters.s: Epindel tests the Captain in a duel, disarms him and insists on following House Orlan’s training curriculum. He realizes guiding the proud heir will be challenging.
Epindel lectures the Captain on noble composure, then panics when a friendly stray dog approaches. She hurriedly denies being afraid and withdraws.
A shortage of horses forces a proposed carriage trip. Epindel’s fear of cramped spaces becomes clear, and the Captain cancels the quest rather than force her through it.
The Captain discovers Epindel ill and alone in her room. He nurses her despite her insistence that an Orlan heir must handle everything independently.
Over dinner, Epindel explains the pressure to remain a flawless heir and asks him to forget her weaknesses. The Captain challenges her to a duel for control of their training.
The Captain counters Epindel’s familiar technique and wins their rematch. He shows her that a safe defeat can reveal ways to improve and promises not to betray her trust.
Epindel enjoys the New Year’s festival with the Captain. When strangers mock his dancing prospects, she leads him onto the floor and helps him through a public waltz.
A family envoy orders Epindel home after the Journey and warns against growing soft. She shares the pressure with the Captain, who reassures her that they can still meet.
Before the final trial, Epindel insists their future rematch matters more than this test. Teasing about her new openness embarrasses her into charging ahead.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Epindel clears the final trial and discusses the value of her trust with the Captain. When he vanishes, she sets aside the celebration to find him.

stories.name: Omega
stories.label: Voyager Savior Party
stories.summary: Alicia’s instructions awaken Omega from the Star Piercer, and the Captain helps the lost artificial girl search for her memories. Cube Palace’s harsh guesses about her past make Omega afraid she will be abandoned unless she is useful. The Captain shows her that she is loved regardless of her power, and a restored recording reveals that she chose to wait in the future herself. After completing the Journey and recovering her mission, Omega accepts the Captain’s disappearance and resolves to protect the world while waiting for him.

chapters.s: Following Alicia’s instructions, Lisa awakens Omega from the Captain’s sword. With her memories missing, Omega accepts his offer to search for her past through the Journey.
Omega’s eager projections overwhelm training and drain her energy until her arms disappear. Bell suggests food, and an enormous meal restores her form.
A button in Omega’s database activates the unstable Cube Palace. With the maids’ help, she reaches it and resets it, saving the city from hostile copies.
Omega asks to keep the recovering Cube Palace in the Captain’s room. She explains that recurring dreams of being left alone have made her afraid to sleep.
Cube Palace identifies Omega as a defense against planetary destruction and says the Journey can restore her. Its guess that she was abandoned for weakness deeply upsets her.
Omega frantically seeks useful tasks as frightening memories return. The Captain asks Cube Palace for a simulation to show her she need not earn their love through strength.
A simulated festival shows Omega that friends would still welcome her if she quit the Journey. She chooses to continue out of love, while the Captain meets a record of her creator.
A restored recording reveals that Omega chose to remain for the future rather than being discarded. She and the Captain record encouragement for her future self.
Before the final trial, Omega saves the Captain’s embrace as a core memory. She prepares to face painful knowledge with the reassurance that she is loved.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Completing the Journey restores Omega’s memories and mission. When the Captain disappears, she chooses to keep smiling, protect the world and patiently await him.

stories.name: Charlotte
stories.label: Heart of Monastir
stories.summary: Charlotte enters the Journey as Monastir’s newly promoted Grand Master, unsure whether her ordinary background fits such a lofty position. The Captain helps her see that endurance, warmth and protecting people matter more than flawless manners. A rescue from a burning building earns her public gratitude and gives her confidence before the final trial. Her story also includes a comic attempt to diet while wearing a bunny outfit, where the city’s tempting food proves a formidable opponent.

chapters.s: Charlotte’s formal introduction collapses under nerves and old habits. The Captain encourages her to speak comfortably so she can focus on their Journey together.
Charlotte asks for harder training and withstands an exhausting session. The next morning, she is fully recovered while the Captain is the one too tired to continue.

chapters.t: My Origins May Not Be Much!
chapters.s: Charlotte explains her common birth and insecurity about becoming Grand Master. She hopes completing the Journey will help her grow into the role.
Encouraging letters remind Charlotte why she wants more strength: to protect Monastir from monsters. The Captain recognizes her resilience as a leader’s true foundation.
Charlotte tries to appear majestic in town but worries when people call her cute. The Captain brings her to a busy restaurant where she can finally eat without self-consciousness.

chapters.t: How About Saying It like This?
chapters.s: Attempts to teach Charlotte dignified speech leave her discouraged. The Captain explains that standing beside others through hardship matters more than polished words.
During the New Year’s festival, Charlotte rushes into a burning building. She holds up the collapsing structure to protect a trapped mother and child until rescuers arrive.
Charlotte visits the recovered mother and child, then receives cheers from townspeople. Their thanks help her speak sincerely and accept her place as Grand Master.
Before the final trial, Charlotte feels strengthened by the city’s support. She promises to keep improving and protect others with new confidence.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Charlotte clears the final trial but finds the Captain gone. She vows to find him, thank him and show him how much further she can grow.
Charlotte attempts a diet and wears a bunny outfit after Carmen’s suggestion. A patrol through food stalls and an unexpected banquet defeat her resolve within a day.

stories.name: Ceres
stories.label: Western Liberators
stories.summary: Ceres brings the harsh discipline of Raven Wall into the Journey, rejecting NOA’s comforts as weakness. Her buried love of desserts leads the Captain to discover that she blames herself for her sister’s death and tries to imitate an impossible ideal. A visit to her sister’s private room reveals that the former commander also needed simple pleasures and wanted Ceres to enjoy life. Ceres learns to draw strength from hope and joy, then completes the Journey determined to help the West and find the missing Captain.

chapters.s: Ceres joins the Journey to gain strength for reclaiming the West. She condemns NOA’s comforts and insists on field rations, despite knowing suspiciously much about desserts.
Ceres destroys practice equipment with her relentless training. Lydia brings her forgotten lunch and hints that the commander needs to loosen up.
A cafeteria meal exposes Ceres’s guilt over enjoying sweets with her late commander. She believes greater discipline might have saved the woman she admired.
Ceres accidentally drinks the Captain’s sweet soda and becomes distracted on a mission. He suggests that constant restraint, rather than pleasure itself, may be the problem.
The Captain finds Ceres staring at parfaits through a cafe window. Accepting a complimentary dessert helps her relax, and her afternoon training improves.
Ceres enjoys more desserts until seeing her relaxed reflection frightens her. She reveals that the former commander was her sister and vows to copy her unshakable strength.
At Raven Wall, the Captain uncovers Ceres’s sister’s hidden novels and journal. Ceres learns that her sister valued rest and wanted her to enjoy life, too.
Ceres tries a tea gathering and struggles with ordinary small talk. Sharing her new interest in sweets and a knightly romance finally helps her connect with other guests.
Before the final trial, Ceres says she no longer fears small joys making her weak. She plans to carry hope and pleasure back to the West.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Ceres completes the Journey and invites the Captain west. After he vanishes, she resolves to secure reinforcements, return home and find the person who guided her.

stories.name: Lydia
stories.label: Western Liberators
stories.summary: Lydia hides a calculating survival instinct behind a sweet, harmless image and trains with the hungry magical book Kuku. Her search for more Void power leads her into a forbidden mine, where her confidence nearly gets her and the Captain killed. His decision to save her despite her deception unsettles her belief that everyone acts only for gain. She remains a schemer, but begins inviting his guidance and, after the final trial, sets out to recover the Captain who vanished without warning.

chapters.s: The Captain interrupts Lydia’s plan to turn an extortion attempt against some thugs and take their wallets. Her helpless country-girl manner proves to be a deliberate act.
Lydia earns free ice cream with a carefully embellished tale of Western hardship. She defends using emotional masks, frustrating the Captain’s attempt to see her more kindly.
Lydia introduces Kuku, the Tome of Gluttony, and her plan to feed it powerful Void sources. She uses the Captain’s embarrassing purchases as leverage to protect her secrets.
Kuku reacts to a dark gem in a thief’s possession. Lydia pressures him into surrendering it and learns that it came from the Nahum Mine.
Lydia researches the closed mine and hears rumors of disappearances. An Observer’s unusually direct warning convinces her that valuable Void power is hidden there.
Lydia ignores restrictions and leads the Captain toward the mine. He pulls her clear of a sudden attack, exposing the limits of her confidence in Kuku.
Lydia lies about resting and returns to the mine alone. The Captain follows and shields her during a collapse while Kuku swallows the Void Core, leaving her shaken by his kindness.

chapters.t: Somewhere Between Hypocrisy and Good Deeds
chapters.s: The Captain finds Lydia volunteering to build influential connections for Western support. Despite her cynical explanation, she asks him to stay close and keep guiding her.
Before the final trial, Lydia offers to help the Captain after the Journey, especially with Void matters. She insists that her reasons remain entirely self-interested.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Lydia clears the final trial and plans more sweets before returning west. When she realizes the Captain is missing from her memories, she vows to find him herself.

stories.name: Professor M
stories.label: Lampadis
stories.summary: Professor M enters the Journey while searching for Detective H, the missing rival who once understood her. A string of murders draws the Captain into her unsettling studies of behavior, judgment and the worth of a life. Suspicion falls on the Professor, but she is cleared after staging a disturbing test of the Captain’s refusal to sacrifice anyone. Her interest shifts toward him as an equal to H, and after the final trial she sets out to find him when he disappears.

chapters.s: The Captain meets Professor M in her obscure laboratory. She explains her studies of human behavior and her wish to find a missing person through the Journey’s power.
The Professor demonstrates her detached way of classifying people during a city walk. The Captain questions whether those categories can truly explain individuals.
The Captain and Professor encounter a murder scene. Her cold deductions and lack of interest in reporting them unsettle him, but he promises to try to understand her.
A second death appears staged, with no clear link to the first. The Professor poses a trolley dilemma, and the Captain refuses to accept sacrificing anyone as the only answer.
As another killing frightens NOA, the Professor questions the Captain’s convictions again. His answer reminds her of the person she is searching for.
Town guards report finding the Professor’s belongings at the crime scenes. Waiting in her lab, the Captain discovers a board naming the victims and a possible next target.
The Professor tests the Captain with an unloaded gun and a claim of guilt. He refuses to shoot her, and she explains her investigation before agreeing to questioning.

chapters.t: To Her, She was Always the One
chapters.s: Cleared of suspicion, the Professor reveals that she seeks Detective H, her missing intellectual rival. She now sees the Captain as another person capable of meeting her expectations.
Before the final trial, the Professor notes that the arrested murderer seems unlike the meticulous culprit. She leaves that question to investigators and focuses on the Journey.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: The Professor completes the Journey and considers opening a detective agency with the Captain. When he disappears, she abandons the party and resolves to track him down.

stories.name: Gwen
stories.label: Lampadis
stories.summary: Gwen introduces herself by mistaking the Captain for a thief, revealing the gap between her grand detective image and erratic deductions. Working beside her, he discovers that persistence, empathy and attention to evidence are her real strengths. A reporter’s taunts and a forged scarlet letter nearly derail her, but she regains her composure and exposes a hidden Voidborn at a press conference. She finishes the Journey more honest about herself and treats the Captain’s disappearance as her next great case.

chapters.s: Gwen mistakes the Captain for a thief and restrains him for interrogation. He dismantles her flimsy evidence, reveals their Journey appointment and receives a frantic apology.
The Captain investigates with Gwen, Lily and the Professor. Gwen’s stubborn stakeout eventually catches the thief, showing the persistence behind Lampadis’s reputation.
A reporter repeatedly compares Gwen with Detective H, upsetting her. Gwen explains that anonymous scarlet letters once guided her cases before H vanished during their rivalry.
The Captain helps Gwen discover her real preferences instead of imitating famous detectives. Her patient search through cat sightings reveals a genuine gift for persistent investigation.

chapters.t: Blink and You Are Done For
chapters.s: Doubting her identity, Gwen asks the Captain to investigate who she really is. His encouragement helps her calmly connect with a frightened suspect and draw out the truth.
Gwen investigates rumors of a human-disguised Voidborn, but slow progress invites criticism. An insulting scarlet letter provokes her into abandoning her newly found approach.
At a difficult press conference, Gwen uses the Captain’s calming exercise and identifies the reporter behind the forged letter. The exposed Voidborn is subdued with Lampadis’s help.
Gwen celebrates the solved case and shares a record of what she has learned about herself. The Captain returns her blank scarlet letter as a reminder to trust her own answers.
Before the final trial, Gwen thanks her dependable sidekick and looks forward to solving more mysteries together. She now recognizes both her effort and his support.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Gwen clears the final trial and dreams of Lampadis’s future fame. When the Captain disappears, she postpones the celebration to investigate where her trusted sidekick went.

stories.name: Harley
stories.label: Hell Saviors
stories.summary: Harley treats the Journey as a great race, bringing her bike hog Dave and the fierce loyalty of the Hell Saviors. Her rough methods repeatedly clash with NOA's guards, while the Captain helps her see that responsibility and restraint can also show strength. Trouble surrounding the destruction of wild hog breeding grounds leads to a kidnapping and a rescue by Harley, her gang, and Claire. After finishing the trial, Harley chooses finding her vanished Captain as the next road to ride.

chapters.s: Harley rescues the Captain during a bike hog chase, then accepts the Journey after her gang describes it as the continent's greatest race.
Harley intimidates a fence to recover a stolen wedding ring. The Captain challenges her rough methods and asks to be treated as a partner.
Harley gives the Captain a dangerously wild bike hog. After a runaway ride, the Captain accepts responsibility and earns her respect.
Harley admits that Dave's unexplained absences have upset her. She explains that she raised him and considers him family.
Following Dave reveals he has a mate and young. Harley explains that railway construction has driven wild hogs from their breeding grounds.
Harley confronts an extortion gang but nearly jeopardizes the Journey through another street fight. She promises the Captain greater self-control.
Ambushed on her way to the festival, Harley endures a beating rather than risk arrest. She still reaches the Captain in time for the last fireworks.
A railway businessman kidnaps the Captain to trap Harley. Her gang and Claire help rescue them, and the disputed hog habitat faces a new review.
Before the final trial, Harley looks forward to new roads and promises to create a path for others if she cannot find one.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Harley and Dave finish the Journey. She resists forgetting the vanished Captain and sets off to find her partner.

stories.name: Petra
stories.label: Petra Construction
stories.summary: Petra joins the Journey hoping to fund her construction company and surpass the firm where an abusive manager once crushed her confidence. Her cheerful act begins to crack under customer disputes and an accident that hurts Tanya. With the Captain, Marcille, and Tanya beside her, she exposes her former manager's smear campaign and rebuilds the company around safety and trust. After the final trial, a familiar keychain helps her remember the vanished Captain and the home she wants to share with them.

chapters.s: The Captain finds Petra eating grass to save money. She explains her struggling company, expensive habits, and ambition to surpass Kemet Industries.
Petra introduces Marcille and Tanya at a chaotic construction job, then tries to leave the work to them and the Captain.
A fraudulent refund demand leaves Petra terrified. The Captain drives the customer away, but Petra avoids explaining her reaction.
Haunted by an abusive former manager, Petra lashes out at her employees. An unsafe bomb goes off, and Tanya is hurt shielding her.

chapters.t: Our Company Is Back in Business
chapters.s: Petra explains her past at Kemet and fears she has become like her old boss. The Captain and her employees help her apologize and return to work.
False rumors drive clients and suppliers away. Petra overhears her former boss trying to recruit her employees, then announces the company will close.
The closure proves to be a trap that draws out Petra's former boss. The Captain records his confession to spreading lies, clearing the way to reopen.
With her company's name cleared, Petra develops safer bombs and dreams of building a home where her friends and the Captain can live happily.
Before the final trial, the Captain calms Petra's nerves. She prepares to demonstrate the strength of her newest bomb.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Petra completes the Journey and talks of a shared future. A fallen recorder keychain helps her remember the missing Captain and leave to find them.

stories.name: Scarlet
stories.label: Little Tyrant
stories.summary: Scarlet joins the Journey to follow her grandmother's legacy and become a Grand Couturier. Her pride and boundless energy cause trouble, but her eagerness to help others gradually points her toward the craft's real meaning. Making a warming coat for a lost child gives her a breakthrough with the precious Bella petal she hopes to sew. The story also includes a bunny outfit episode in which her misplaced confidence exposes an unexpected sensitivity.

chapters.s: Scarlet breaks into the Captain's quarters and introduces her ambition to become a Grand Couturier, believing the Journey will lead her to Alicia.
Scarlet explains the Bella flower, her inherited shears, and the elusive technique behind her grandmother's craft, then joins children in a game.
Scarlet uproots trees to keep children safe but destroys birds' nests. After replanting them, she faces Claire's anger over another unwanted decoration.
Scarlet seeks inspiration around town and eagerly helps a stream of residents with physical tasks.
Scarlet explains how curiosity and lifelong ideals protect dragons from mental erosion, then struggles to demonstrate her supposedly mighty fire breath.
Scarlet makes the Captain an extravagantly decorated outfit as thanks, unaware that its appearance draws uncomfortable attention.
Scarlet misses a play to help repair a festival rocket, disguising its damaged body with a large likeness of herself.
Scarlet helps find a lost child and sews her a warming coat. Genuine care for its wearer brings a breakthrough in her tailoring.
Before the final trial, Scarlet shows that she can now embroider the Bella petal and promises the Captain a charm.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Scarlet completes the Journey, then postpones her hoped-for meeting with Alicia to search for the vanished Captain who helped guide her craft.
Scarlet shows the Captain a handmade bunny outfit. An unexpected reaction to her tail being touched turns the visit into an awkward private training session.

stories.name: Claire
stories.label: Flawless Blue Rose
stories.summary: Claire joins the Journey hoping to become a Master Maid worthy of Carnelia's example. A former biking rival draws out the past she has tried to erase, making her question whether she belongs at Candle Square. With the Captain and her fellow maids' support, she learns to pursue her own path rather than copy her predecessor. A bonus episode places her in a chaotic bunny costume magic show organized by Luna.

chapters.s: Claire explains how Carnelia saved her and inspired her ambition to become Master Maid, relying on the detailed handbook Carnelia left her.
Claire insists on proper paperwork and explains the dedication behind her tightly planned work as a maid.
Scarlet's decorations and Bell's expensive stone purchase test Claire's patience. The Captain worries about her habit of suppressing anger.
A herd of bike hogs invades Candle Square. Claire organizes the response and reveals unexpectedly detailed knowledge of handling them.
A threatening letter exposes Claire's past as biker leader Thorn Vine. She rides out with the Captain to confront an old rival's challenge.
Restless after the confrontation, Claire secretly rides at night. The Captain catches her under a hastily invented identity and agrees to keep it secret.
Claire considers resigning because she cannot match Carnelia's image. The Captain, Bell, and Scarlet convince her that she is needed as herself.

chapters.t: Then Came a Lot of Cleaning
chapters.s: Claire decides to grow beyond her handbook and become respected in her own name, then helps the Captain confront an extremely messy room.
Before the final trial, Claire resolves to acknowledge her past while following her own path toward becoming Master Maid.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Claire completes the Journey, but the Captain disappears. Choosing her own response rather than copying Carnelia, she leaves to find them.
Claire reluctantly assists Luna's magic show in a bunny outfit. A faulty escape tank and a slime turn the performance into a public disaster.

stories.name: Luna
stories.label: White Pearl Trap
stories.summary: Luna joins the Journey while buried in gambling debts and draws the Captain into her financial troubles. Her accurate prophecies have convinced her that effort cannot change fate, but the Captain keeps trying to show her a worthwhile future. Failed jobs lead to unexpected good outcomes, and a shared gamble helps her rediscover hope. After the final trial, Luna resolves to meet the vanished Captain again, even though she cannot foresee their reunion. A beach episode adds another comic challenge to her fatalistic outlook.

chapters.s: Luna arrives fleeing creditors and persuades the Captain to guarantee debts she built up through gambling.
The Captain finds Luna gambling instead of training. Her attempts to read the Captain's blurry future end in mishaps.
Finding Luna sleeping outdoors, the Captain gets her clean and fed, then learns she has already borrowed against the Journey reward.
A creditor reveals that Luna once helped save his mother. The Captain negotiates more time and decides Luna needs honest work.
Luna's fortune-telling stall succeeds, but its unlicensed earnings are seized. She says her prophecies show a future that cannot change.
Monster hunting, weeding, and mail delivery all go wrong. Luna takes the repeated setbacks as proof that honest effort is pointless.
The Captain discovers good outcomes behind their failed jobs and wins a gamble that pays part of Luna's debt, giving her fresh hope.
Luna recalls seeing the world's end. After another gambling loss, she and the Captain work as cleaners, and she buys them a simple meal.
Luna recalls her master's prophecy about someone who could create a future beyond the end. Before the trial, she asks the Captain's name.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Luna passes the final trial and credits the Captain for her renewed hope. When they vanish, she vows to meet them again.
At the beach, Luna reveals she pawned her clothes to buy supplies. An escaping crab challenges her claim that struggling against fate is pointless.

stories.name: Smile
stories.label: Sunshine Cat
stories.summary: Smile, a self-described homunculus, joins the Journey to learn how to smile and help her missing sister become human. Her inventions lead to disastrous experiments until the Captain shifts their search toward companionship. Building a pair of robotic cats helps Smile discover that caring about someone can bring real happiness. After the final trial, she remembers the vanished Captain and sets out to find the person who matters to her. A summer episode follows her attempt to beat the heat with snacks and an overpowered fan.

chapters.s: Smile tests the Captain with a lie detector and explains that she joined the Journey to learn how to smile.
Smile's first potion experiment leaves the Captain laughing uncontrollably for a week.
Smile reveals her wish to help her missing sister become human. Her next experiment traps the Captain in a runaway tickling machine.
The Captain takes Smile to a cafe, theater, and park to find something she enjoys. A girl with a cat catches her attention.
After they fail to catch a cat, the Captain makes Smile a stuffed one as a gift.
Smile gives the stuffed cat a mechanical body, but its built-in weapon fires on them and destroys the Captain's room.
During the New Year festival, they find the escaped robot cat watching kittens. The Captain suggests making it a companion.
Seeing two robot cats become friends brings out Smile's first smile. She and the Captain plan to search for her sister together.
Before the final trial, Smile says a photo of someone important helped confirm the Captain's idea about happiness.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: After completing the Journey, Smile realizes the Captain has vanished. She starts searching for the person she cares about.
The Captain helps Smile cool off with cold snacks and her custom fan. Pressing its unfinished boost button sends the Captain flying.

stories.name: Lacy
stories.label: Wanderer
stories.summary: Lacy, a dragon author in a long creative slump, enters the Journey seeking inspiration and starts training the Captain instead of accepting their guidance. The Captain helps her revisit the human friendship that first inspired her writing, only to discover how little time her old friend has left. Their shared effort gives the friends a final farewell, and Lacy turns that bond into a successful new story. After the trial, she senses the mystery behind the vanished Captain's power and refuses to lose another important person through delay.

chapters.s: Lacy examines the Captain's unusual energy and decides to train them into a suitable protagonist for her next book.
Lacy overwhelms the Captain with dangerous training until they agree to train together, reversing their expected roles.
Lacy overhears harsh criticism of her recent books. The Captain sees how deeply her creative slump hurts her.
Training awakens a strange experience of events before they happen, then the Captain collapses. Hoping to help Lacy write again, they suggest an outing.
Lacy's first story reveals the human friend who inspired her to write. The Captain persuades her to visit after decades apart.
Lacy discovers her old friend is now elderly and in a coma. Regretting her delay, she begins sharing the stories she saved for their reunion.
When her friend worsens, Lacy and the Captain spend their strength to give her a final conversation and farewell.
Lacy's new book about the dragon and the girl wins eager readers. She thanks the Captain for helping her recover the meaning in her writing.
Before the final trial, Lacy excitedly plans her next story while the Captain chooses to wait and read it as a fan.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Lacy completes the Journey and offers the Captain an editor's role. After their disappearance, she recognizes something extraordinary in their power and leaves to find them.

stories.name: Tanya
stories.label: Petra Construction
stories.summary: Tanya joins the Journey without knowing what she wants, relying on the lessons of her friends at Petra Construction. The Captain turns training into games and discovers her remarkable strength, generous heart, and extraordinary gift for fried food. Running a festival stall helps her see that her friends, cooking, and time with the Captain already give her life meaning. After completing the Journey, she leaves to find the vanished Captain and bring everyone together for another meal.

chapters.s: After feeding a hungry Tanya, the Captain learns about her work at Petra Construction and offers to help her discover what she wants.
Ordinary drills fail to interest Tanya, but turning training into games draws out her remarkable speed and strength.
Tanya criticizes a restaurant's fried food, then demonstrates such skill that the humbled owner asks to become her apprentice.
The Captain buys Tanya plushies resembling her friends. Her grateful hug reveals just how poorly she controls her strength.
Trying to repay the Captain, Tanya turns a faucet repair into a plumbing disaster. Their reassurance helps her face the mistake.
Tanya struggles to identify a goal beyond things she likes. Hearing her apprentice's festival plans gives her an idea of her own.
With the Captain and her apprentices' help, Tanya runs a successful festival fried food stall and discovers the joy of serving others.
Tanya demonstrates better control and repairs the faucet. She realizes that her friends, fried food, and the Captain are already what she wants.
Before the final trial, Tanya promises to fulfill the Captain's wish by completing the Journey and cooking a celebratory meal.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Tanya completes the Journey and then senses the Captain's absence. She sets off to find them so her four friends can share fried food again.

stories.name: Lily
stories.label: Lampadis
stories.summary: Lily enters the Journey with dreams of investigation and a talking stuffed companion, Mr. Rabbit, who sometimes borrows her body. Her kindness makes her an easy target for demands and scams, so the Captain helps her practice setting boundaries. When Mr. Rabbit disappears, the people she has helped become the network that brings him back, proving that her compassion is also a strength. She completes the Journey with greater confidence and turns that growing independence toward finding her missing Captain.

chapters.s: The Captain meets Lily and her sharp-tongued companion Mr. Rabbit, whose strange powers protect her from a bullying mercenary.
Lily introduces Lampadis and explains how her search for the vanished Detective H led Gwen to hire her as an assistant investigator.
Lily investigates a frightening alley shadow with the Captain. Mr. Rabbit helps identify an oversized squirrel rather than a supernatural monster.

chapters.t: The Look of an Easy Mark
chapters.s: A fake Detective H keepsake nearly draws Lily into a scam. She admits that fear of unfairly rejecting good people makes her vulnerable.
After more delays caused by strangers' requests, Lily asks for help saying no. Advice from her colleagues fails to suit her gentle nature.
A timed search gives Lily practice refusing distractions, but she stops to help a bullied boy. The Captain praises her choice to protect someone in need.

chapters.t: The Case of Mr. Rabbit's Disappearance
chapters.s: Mr. Rabbit is stolen, and Lily's many grateful acquaintances help track him down. Her kindness proves as useful as deduction.
During a haunted house inquiry, Mr. Rabbit borrows an unconscious Lily's body, solves the mystery, and privately thanks the Captain for helping her grow.
Before the final trial, the Captain frames encouragement as a request Lily cannot refuse, easing her nerves.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Lily finishes the Journey and invites the Captain to keep visiting Lampadis. When they vanish, she begins a new search using her own methods.

stories.name: Kyra
stories.label: Kyra Doesn't Have Friends
stories.summary: Kyra fears speaking because her uncontrolled Kotodama can turn words into dangerous actions. Discovering that the Captain is unaffected gives her a first chance to speak freely, but her gratitude becomes intense attachment and jealousy. With encouragement and focused practice, she learns to control her power well enough to rescue someone who once feared her. She completes the Journey with stronger abilities, yet still sees the missing Captain as a destined partner whom she must find.

chapters.s: Kyra nervously meets the Captain and reveals Kotodama, a power that makes her words affect reality and has left her afraid to speak.
Testing shows Kyra's words do not affect the Captain. For the first time, she feels able to talk freely without fearing she will hurt her listener.
Kyra grows intensely attached and pressures a fortune teller to confirm that she and the Captain are destined to be together.
Kyra borrows recklessly for gifts and enters the Captain's room with copied keys. The Captain rejects both the debts and her boundary-crossing behavior.

chapters.t: Keep Your Eyes Locked on Kyra!
chapters.s: Kyra's jealousy leads to a confrontation, revealing that she has been tracking the Captain and recording their daily life.
An encounter with old playmates reveals how accidental injuries caused by her power left Kyra isolated and afraid of rejection.
The Captain reassures Kyra but challenges her dependence, then helps her practice precise control of Kotodama to build confidence in herself.

chapters.t: One Slow Step at a Time?
chapters.s: Kyra safely uses her power to rescue an old playmate and apologizes for the past. Her growing confidence still comes with an intense attachment to the Captain.
Before the final trial, Kyra relies on the Captain's reassurance and promises to fight with everything she has.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Kyra completes the Journey and imagines a shared future. When the Captain vanishes, she vows to track down the person she believes fate chose for her.

stories.name: Asherah
stories.label: Waltz of Starlight
stories.summary: Asherah joins the Journey hoping to follow the Star Savior, but her eagerness to grow quickly leads to a painful setback. The Captain helps with daily life and teaches her to trust companions rather than race toward her dream alone. Alicia's account of the hero strengthens her resolve before the final trial. An additional episode finds her determined to keep training even when her only spare outfit is a dress.

chapters.s: Asherah introduces herself as an eager new Journey member. She tells the Captain how childhood stories of the Star Savior inspired her dream of protecting Lavistar.
Poor meals leave Asherah weak during training. The Captain teaches her simple cooking and shares a spicy dinner while reflecting on his own unclear past.
At the library, Asherah investigates the Star Savior's disappearance. She reveals her wish to become a worthy Savior and someday meet her childhood hero.
Asherah grows impatient with routine training and asks for more real combat. The Captain warns her about its risks but agrees to include another quest.
Asherah secretly hunts alone, falls into a Raider trap and sprains her ankle while escaping. The failure shakes her confidence in her dream.

chapters.t: If You Want to Go Far
chapters.s: Over dinner, Asherah admits her doubts and explains why she ran from her noble home. The Captain reminds her that distant goals can be reached together.
Asherah takes the Captain around NOA's New Year festival. Watching the rocket launch together, she reflects on how her dream has begun to change.
Alicia replies to the Captain's letter about the Star Savior. Her account of an ordinary person's perseverance helps Asherah approach the final trial with renewed clarity.
Before the final trial, Asherah thanks the Captain for helping her grow beyond her childhood ideal. They promise to visit her hometown after the Journey.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Asherah completes the Journey, but the Captain disappears and Lisa remembers no one else. Refusing to forget him, Asherah sets out to find him.
A torn training outfit leaves Asherah borrowing a dress from Scarlet. She completes her drills in it before Emily finds spare uniforms, ending an awkward training day.

stories.name: Carmen
stories.label: Eternal Promise
stories.summary: Carmen joins the Journey to bring new experience back to the Monastir Knights. Behind her teasing composure, she hides punishing extra training and anxiety about protecting others. The Captain helps her recognize that a dependable shield must also rest and accept support. An extra episode explores her protective work through playful scenarios while she wears a wedding dress.

chapters.s: Carmen, Deputy Master of the Monastir Knights, joins Voyager to learn from the Journey. Her teasing introduction leaves the Captain curious about what she hides behind her smile.
Carmen demonstrates her skill with a remarkably heavy shield. Noticing the Captain's stiffness, she teaches him the Knights' stretching routine.
The Captain brings Carmen a rare tart and finds her returning late with her weapons. A fresh scratch raises doubts about her claim that she was only taking a walk.
The Captain discovers Carmen training secretly at night. Concerned that she is overworking, he stays to help after trying her potent recovery soup.
After more night training, Carmen shares Monastir mead and the Knights' tradition of passing a cup. She speaks about fallen comrades and the wish to protect those still living.
Carmen's exhaustion finally disrupts training. The Captain challenges the anxious perfectionism behind her composure, and she agrees to rest.
Carmen invites the Captain to enjoy New Year without her weapons. Over mead and fireworks, she admits her fears and hopes to protect peaceful days without hiding from herself.
Carmen offers homemade snacks with strong medicinal effects and terrible flavors. Even the ordinary-looking cupcake leaves the Captain questioning her cooking.
Before the final trial, Carmen says she no longer needs to conceal her feelings. She hopes to spend more time traveling with the Captain after completing the Journey.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Carmen completes the Journey and accepts that she can lean on the Captain. When he disappears and Lisa cannot remember him, Carmen leaves to find the person she wants to protect.
While sorting escort disguises, Carmen tries on an unused wedding dress. She and the Captain act out protection scenarios that become increasingly playful and leave him flustered.

stories.name: Epindel
stories.label: Blessing in Bloom
stories.summary: Epindel begins the Journey determined to prove herself as House Orlan's heir and insists on directing her own training. The Captain gradually sees the fears and loneliness beneath her polished image. A rematch teaches her that exposing weaknesses to a trusted companion can help her grow rather than destroy her position. An extra episode gives a wedding dress unexpected personal meaning when the Captain helps her through a rainstorm.

chapters.s: Epindel introduces herself as House Orlan's heir and tests the Captain in a duel. After disarming him, she proposes using her family's training curriculum for the Journey.
Epindel supervises her own training and lectures the Captain on noble composure. A friendly stray dog unexpectedly reveals a fear she refuses to admit.
A trip by carriage exposes Epindel's fear of confined spaces. The Captain stops the ride and cancels the quest rather than let her continue hiding her distress.
Finding Epindel ill and alone, the Captain stays to care for her. Her insistence that an Orlan must stand alone begins to soften as she accepts his help.
Over dinner, Epindel reveals the family pressure behind her ambition. The Captain proposes a duel whose stakes are whether she will trust him with her weaknesses.
The Captain counters Epindel's familiar technique and wins their rematch. He shows her how shared practice turns a defeat into a chance to improve.
Epindel joins the Captain at the New Year festival. When strangers mock his dancing ability, she guides him onto the dance floor and they enjoy the evening together.
A family envoy orders Epindel home after the Journey and warns against growing comfortable. The Captain reassures her that their bond need not end with the trial.
Before the final trial, the Captain teases Epindel about their postponed rematch. Flustered, she rushes ahead while Lisa struggles to deliver the briefing.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: After passing the trial, Epindel acknowledges her trust in the Captain. When he disappears from everyone else's memory, she refuses to forget him and leaves to find him.
Epindel models a wedding dress but is stranded by rain after refusing a carriage. The Captain carries her home, giving the dress a cherished meaning she had not expected.

stories.name: Frey
stories.label: Noble Princess
stories.summary: Frey approaches the Journey as a chance to build the fortune she believes Monastir needs. Repeated schemes and scams give way to a successful honey-candy business after the Captain encourages her to start small. Beneath her mercenary talk lies a wish to make her country safe and prosperous. An extra episode sees her latest publishing venture derailed when Charlotte interrupts a costume photo shoot.

chapters.s: Frey introduces herself as Monastir's quartermaster and pitches a Savior investment scheme. Hoping to use the Captain's supposed connections, she is frustrated to learn he cannot provide them.
Frey buys a stock of heating mats for a pyramid-selling venture. The Captain spots that the mats are fake, sending her after the people who cheated her.
Frey tries to recruit Lisa into another pyramid scheme. Their calculations reveal it needs more customers than Lavistar has people, and Lisa withdraws.
Business failures make Frey consider leaving the Journey. The Captain suggests that completing it could earn useful fame, restoring her motivation to train.

chapters.t: The Reason I Want to Be Rich
chapters.s: Frey explains that she wants wealth to break Monastir's cycle of monster attacks and poverty. The Captain encourages her to begin that ambitious goal with a small business.
Frey's honey candy succeeds through flavor, branding and a genuine donation pledge. She proudly describes ordinary good marketing as a cunning business strategy.
Frey hides from Charlotte after using Knights' reserve funds to expand her candy business. She insists the investment will pay off and tries to escape into more training.
An allowance cut leaves Frey skipping meals, while her candy profits have gone toward relief in Monastir. The Captain offers food, and she promises repayment with interest.
Before the final trial, Frey thanks the Captain for helping her see the Journey's value. She invites him to serve Monastir alongside her in the future.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Frey passes the Journey and plans to celebrate with the Captain. After his sudden disappearance, she postpones the party to find the person she needs and repay her debt.
Frey recruits the Captain to photograph her in a bunny outfit for a new magazine venture. Charlotte interrupts, confiscates the camera and photos, and escorts Frey away.

stories.name: Amora
stories.label: House Stranis
stories.summary: Amora Stranis joins the Journey in her daughter's place, already possessing the strength of one of Alicia's executors. The Captain discovers that her real need is room to live beyond the duties of a noble house and a protective mother. Play, conversation and unexpected danger help her reconnect with a childhood dream of her own. Beneath her constant teasing, she comes to value someone who walks beside her rather than merely relying on her strength.

chapters.s: Countess Amora arrives instead of her daughter, who was caught trying to leave home. The Captain recognizes her own curiosity about the Journey and promises to guide her.
Amora handles training and a support mission easily despite her constant drinking. The Captain asks her to cut back out of concern for her wellbeing rather than her performance.

chapters.t: Cast Off the Weight of the Crown
chapters.s: Learning that Amora is Alicia's executor, the Captain searches for a new kind of training. A day at the playground helps her briefly set aside her responsibilities and enjoy herself.
Over drinks, Amora recalls a stranger who helped her home as a lost child and inspired her interest in the Journey. The Captain urges her to live for herself as well as her duties.
An assassin mistakes the Captain for Count Stranis and attacks the pair. Fighting together, they stop him and discuss how Amora's burdens need not leave her alone.
Trying to surprise Amora, the Captain interrupts her skincare routine and angers her. With Lisa's help, he buys an apology gift that prompts more teasing about jealousy.
The Captain takes Amora to a New Year viewing deck where alcohol is banned. Without her usual drink, she becomes shy about their closeness before they watch fireworks from a park.

chapters.t: The One Who Walks Beside Me
chapters.s: Amora reflects on the path the Journey has opened beyond her responsibilities. She remains afraid for her daughter, but begins to understand the value of a companion who guides rather than confines.
Before the final trial, Amora teases the Captain about how quickly their time passed. She hopes to keep seeing him after returning to her estate.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Amora completes the Journey and remembers the vanished Captain despite Lisa's confusion. Knowing where she now wants to go, she looks toward meeting him again.

stories.name: Ceres
stories.label: Sharp & Sweet
stories.summary: Ceres enters the Journey seeking the strength to reclaim the West and believing that pleasure weakens a soldier. The Captain gradually introduces her to ordinary meals and desserts, exposing the grief behind her severe self-denial. A visit to her late sister's room reveals that even her admired predecessor needed private joys and rest. Ceres learns to seek a future worth enjoying, with an extra episode exploring a surprisingly martial idea of maid work.

chapters.s: Ceres joins Voyager to gain power and reinforcements for the Western Liberators. She scorns NOA's comfort, though her detailed knowledge of desserts hints at hidden curiosity.
Ceres's destructive training reflects the West's desperate fighting style and her late commander's legacy. Lydia arrives with lunch and tries to ease her commander's rigid habits.
A simple cafeteria meal challenges Ceres's image of NOA's luxury. She recalls sharing a parfait with her former commander and links enjoying it to the grief of losing her.
Ceres secretly drinks the Captain's sweet soda during a mission and becomes distracted. He suggests that relentless denial, rather than the drink, may be troubling her.
The Captain finds Ceres staring at parfaits outside a cafe. Sharing one helps her discover that a brief pleasure can refresh her mind and improve her training.
Ceres enjoys more desserts until seeing her relaxed reflection alarms her. She reveals that the former commander was her sister and vows to abandon these outings.
With Lydia's help, the Captain takes Ceres to her sister's old room. A hidden journal reveals the hobbies, rest and affection beneath her predecessor's flawless public image.
Ceres tries socializing at a tea party, awkwardly turning small talk toward the battlefield. Desserts and her sister's favorite novels finally help her connect with the others.
Before the final trial, Ceres says she now understands strength as keeping hope and joy alive. She plans to find new pleasures after returning to the West.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Ceres completes the Journey and invites the Captain west. When he disappears from others' memory, she sets out to find him alongside her plans to aid the Liberators.
Considering life after reclaiming the West, Ceres decides to try being a maid. Her battle-focused approach culminates in proudly springing a trap to protect her supposed master.

stories.name: Lydia
stories.label: Ready-Made Puppy
stories.summary: Lydia joins the Journey with a sweet public mask, a cynical view of people and a dangerous living tome called Kuku. Her search for powerful food for the book leads her and the Captain to a mine corrupted by Void Force. When her confidence puts them both in danger, the Captain's refusal to abandon her challenges her belief that every kindness needs a selfish purpose. She keeps her sharp tongue, but increasingly asks him to remain beside her.

chapters.s: The Captain interrupts Lydia's plan to turn an attempted robbery against the thugs. His new Journey member admits she was acting helpless so she could take their money.
Lydia wins free ice cream with an embellished story about the West. She argues that everyone uses a mask to get what they want, unsettling the Captain.
Lydia introduces Kuku, a living tome that grows stronger by eating powerful things. She reveals plans to feed it the West's Void Core and pressures the Captain to keep quiet.
Kuku reacts to a stolen stone, prompting Lydia to corner its thief. She learns it came from Nahum Mine and feeds the Void-infused stone to her book.
Lydia researches the abandoned Nahum Mine and hears of disappearances. An Observer's warning makes her more determined to investigate it as a possible feast for Kuku.
At the restricted mine, Lydia finds signs of spreading Void Force and narrowly avoids an attack. The Captain challenges her certainty that she can control every risk.
Lydia lies to return to the mine alone, and the Captain follows. He shields her during a collapse while Kuku eats the core, leaving her shaken by his willingness to save her.

chapters.t: Somewhere Between Hypocrisy and Good Deeds
chapters.s: The Captain finds Lydia volunteering to cultivate useful noble connections. Beneath her cynical explanation, she asks him to keep watching over her and accepts his help serving soup.
Before the final trial, Lydia thanks the Captain while insisting their future cooperation will benefit her too. Kuku remains restless after consuming the mine's core.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Lydia completes the Journey and anticipates a final tour of NOA's sweets. After the Captain disappears, she recalls his help at the mine and resolves to track him down.

stories.name: Asherah
stories.label: Witch of Favoritism
stories.summary: The Witch of Favoritism awakens in a strangely familiar Journey with gaps in her memory and a Captain she insists is only an imitation. Memories of Asherah's earlier hopes return despite her efforts to bury them. The Captain's steady care draws out the grief behind her repeated attempts to save him from a fate he chose. As the Journey ends, she begins to accept her own feelings instead of denying the person she once was.

chapters.s: The Witch of Favoritism awakens in NOA, disoriented and unwilling to join the Journey. She pushes away the familiar Captain and refuses to give him a name.
A gap in her memory leaves the witch already training as a Journey member. She calls it meaningless, but the Captain insists he will not give up on her happiness.
During a hunt, the witch instinctively shields the Captain and is wounded. His warmth and a familiar saying rekindle feelings she thought she had buried.
Books about the Star Savior trigger memories of Asherah's hopes. A folded marriage document brings another fragment of the past back to the witch.
The witch confronts an inner image of Asherah and painful memories of failure. In a hospital room, she asks the visiting Captain to leave her alone.
After burning the marriage document, the witch speaks with the waiting Captain about loss and doomed futures. He offers a festival invitation rather than abandoning her.
At the New Year launch, the witch recalls a wish to remain beside the Captain. She quietly makes a new wish for his suffering to end and for him to return home safely.
The witch finally voices her anguish over the Captain's sacrifices. His explanation of why he chooses to protect others breaks through her defenses, and they share apologies.
Before the final trial, the witch recalls their promise to visit her home. She accepts her past self and chooses to let the Captain return to his own home instead.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: At the Journey's end, the witch and Captain part with promises to remember and meet again. When he asks her name once more, she finally begins to answer.

stories.name: Besta
stories.label: Western Liberators
