stories.summary: Besta joins the Journey as a capable Western Liberator, but soon reveals a private imagination unlike her stern public image. A misleading warning from Lydia makes her fear that her fantasies are signs of fatal Void corruption. The Captain encourages her to find reasons to live beyond reclaiming the West and to trust him with the uncertain risks of her power. Their bond gives her a future to anticipate as well as a duty to fulfill.

chapters.s: Besta formally reports for the Journey and explains her hope of reclaiming the West. Everyday encounters in NOA begin revealing a surprising private side behind her disciplined manner.
Besta explains that childhood exposure let her use some Void Force. Her repeated nosebleeds turn out to come from an active imagination inspired by ordinary encounters around NOA.
Besta says the Captain is the only person she can share her hidden interests with. A call from Ceres and Lydia also reveals how much essential work she handled in the West.
During a slime hunt, the Captain notices Besta taking unnecessary hits. She reveals a personal reason for choosing a shield beyond protecting her comrades.
Besta collapses and receives treatment for anemia. Lydia claims her fantasies reflect growing Void corruption and warns her to stop, leaving Besta deeply alarmed.
Besta's attempts to suppress her imagination fail, and she starts thinking only of surviving long enough to reclaim the West. The Captain urges her to find something she wants to live for.

chapters.t: Next Year, and the Year After
chapters.s: Besta enjoys festival contests and fireworks with the Captain. Planning to return next year gives her a hopeful future beyond merely completing her duty.
Lydia admits lying about the fantasies but privately warns that Besta's Void power still poses risks. The Captain promises to respect Besta's choices and face those risks with her.
Before the final trial, Besta reaffirms her determination to reclaim the West. The Captain encourages her as her unruly imagination continues to interrupt her formal resolve.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Besta completes the Journey and thanks the Captain for caring for her. After his disappearance, she holds onto their promise to watch fireworks together again.

stories.name: Annah
stories.label: NOA Town Guard
stories.summary: Annah joins the Journey while investigating a public-indecency suspect whose black coat resembles the Captain's. Her arrest-minded habits and close attention leave him wondering whether he remains under suspicion. Shared training, donuts and a dramatic festival pursuit reveal both her trust in him and her true position in the Town Guard. By the end, she regards him as an irreplaceable partner whose familiar scent she will not forget.

chapters.s: Annah introduces herself as a Town Guard arrest specialist and briefly cuffs the Captain. His clothing matches a wanted suspect's, but he proves he is wearing clothes beneath his coat.
Rumors about the black-coated suspect keep following the Captain. Annah's constant questions and attention make him worry she still suspects him despite her assurances.
Annah practices full arrest procedures even against training dummies. She proudly explains her work while dodging questions about why she cuffed the Captain at their first meeting.

chapters.t: Not Really My Cup of Tea
chapters.s: Annah brings donuts to the Captain's late-night planning session. Her insistence on teaching him the differences between varieties reveals how much she enjoys them.
Annah takes the Captain for a close, snack-filled walk and calls him her partner. At Town Guard headquarters, he finally voices his fear that the outing is another attempt to arrest him.
The Captain spots the real suspect while washing up and gives chase, losing most of his clothes along the way. Annah reassures him that her sense of smell has always distinguished them.
At the New Year festival, Annah and the Captain pursue the suspect through a chaotic vehicle chase. Even fireworks smoke cannot stop her recognizing her partner and arresting the culprit.
The Captain receives a Brave Citizen Award for helping solve the case. Annah surprises him by presenting it as the Chief of the Town Guard.
Before the final trial, Annah debates how arrest procedures apply to Voidborns. A familiar scent at the trial site leaves her unusually calm and reminds her of the Captain.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Annah completes the Journey and invites the Captain to join the Town Guard. When he disappears, she delays the party and follows her memory of his scent to find her partner.

stories.name: Marcille
stories.label: Petra Construction
stories.summary: Marcille joins the Journey to support her family and eventually build a carrot farm. Her pride makes accepting help difficult, although she readily teaches the Captain construction skills. Working together and visiting a festival reveal the care behind her sharp temper. She learns to share that care through a partnership she insists on calling a deal.

chapters.s: The Captain and Marcille are accidentally swept into a construction crew. Her skill impresses him before teasing about her size sparks an argument.
At a tool shop, Marcille enthusiastically explains her favorites. A clerk mistakes the pair for a couple, leaving her flustered.
Marcille struggles with a farming book while planning her carrot farm. The Captain buys seeds in exchange for part of her future harvest.

chapters.t: It's Different When It's a Deal
chapters.s: The Captain proves he remembers Marcille's lessons and helps finish a job. She explains her family's hardship and accepts him as a working partner.
A repair job goes smoothly until Marcille gets stuck in a wall opening. A cockroach prompts her to demand a less economical rescue.
Locked out of his room, the Captain stays with Marcille in exchange for cooking. She adds a festival outing to their deal.
Marcille enjoys her first festival while buying gifts for family. Seeing children return to cold, poor homes gives her an idea.
Marcille and the Captain repair homes for free. She calls it advertising, but her care for families in hardship is clear.
Before the final trial, Marcille invites the Captain to keep working with her. His teasing leaves her embarrassed but determined to finish.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Marcille completes the Journey, still focused on her family and farm. When the Captain vanishes, she resolves to find her missing partner.

stories.name: Vera
stories.label: Courier Guild
stories.summary: Vera joins the Journey hoping to afford a cruiser and return to hazard deliveries. Her courier instincts already make her remarkably capable, although direct combat feels unfamiliar. A generous corporate offer forces her to examine what she values about the work. With the Captain's support, she chooses a path that preserves the care she puts into each delivery.

chapters.s: Vera delivers a notice naming herself as the Captain's new recruit. Journey support money offers a faster route toward her dream cruiser.
Vera treats sparring as an escape exercise. When the Captain makes protecting cargo the goal, her hidden strength appears immediately.
The Captain accompanies Vera on deliveries and sees her handle dogs, thieves and tight schedules. Her cheerful manner conceals impressive practical skill.
Vera examines vehicles with expert knowledge. She explains her wish to return to hazard courier work and the journeys she shared with her mentor.
A large company offers Vera equipment and a courier position if she leaves the Journey. The Captain suggests touring its operation before deciding.
The company's equipment impresses Vera, but careless deliveries and restrictive leasing terms trouble her. She questions whether it suits her values.

chapters.t: The Fast Way and the Right Way
chapters.s: Vera delivers a replacement festival cake through a dangerous route. Seeing the recipients' happiness helps her decide to reject the company's offer.
Vera plans a thoughtful day out for the Captain. It ends beside a rented cruiser, where her ocarina shares a memory of the life she wants to keep.
Before the final trial, the Captain tells Vera to imagine recovering stolen cargo. Trusting her courier instincts settles her nerves.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Vera completes the Journey and calls the Captain her second mentor. His disappearance sends her searching, still determined to buy her cruiser.

stories.name: Naru
stories.label: Orbital Search Team
stories.summary: Naru dreams of perfect disaster prediction after losing her village to an unlikely attack. Her confidence and impulsive experiments create repeated trouble for the Captain. A failed evacuation prediction nearly makes her abandon her research entirely. Support from the Captain and her seniors helps her recognize useful progress without giving up her larger goal.

chapters.s: Naru's attempt to avert a predicted accident causes chaos in the plaza. Roberta assigns the newly selected recruit to the Captain's care.
Naru tests her prediction equation around NOA, misreading incidents and causing damage. A mistaken attack leaves her and the Captain writing reports.
On cleaning duty, Naru tries to process all the rubbish at once. A sneeze ruins the spell and sends them back to incident reports.
While fishing, Naru explains how a low-probability disaster destroyed her village. The Captain promises to support her search for reliable predictions.
New ideas keep Naru working through the night and sleeping during training. She promises the Captain will see her completed equation first.
Naru predicts a village flood and persuades her seniors to evacuate it. When no flood comes, she loses confidence and destroys her notes.
Villagers explain that her warning prompted useful repairs. A later prediction helps prevent a festival fire, winning cautious support for her research.

chapters.t: You, Me, the Stars, and Equations
chapters.s: Naru thanks the Captain with a starlit outing. She gives the equation a personal name and asks him to remain beside her as she works toward her dream.
Naru approaches the final trial excited about her future. She insists the Captain will stay close when she eventually reaches NOA's highest office.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Naru completes the Journey, then detects a gap where the Captain should be. Finding him becomes more urgent than prestige or her equation.

stories.name: Claire
stories.label: Candle Square
stories.summary: Claire hopes completing the Journey will help her become a Master Maid worthy of Carnelia's example. Her strict devotion to rules conceals a past she has tried to erase. A rival biker draws that past back into view and makes Claire question her place at Candle Square. The Captain and her fellow maids help her see that she can serve well by following her own path.

chapters.s: Claire explains how Carnelia saved her and inspired her to become a maid. She relies on Carnelia's guidebook while filling the absent Master Maid's role.
Claire insists on completing every required document properly. Her demanding schedule shows how strongly she equates service with personal dedication.
Claire manages Scarlet's pranks and Bell's unauthorized purchase while suppressing her anger. The Captain worries about the strain beneath her composure.
A herd of bike hogs overruns Candle Square. Claire organizes the response with unusual expertise, then gives the captured animals elaborate names.
A challenge letter exposes Claire's former life as a biker leader. She rides out with the Captain to prevent a threatened attack on NOA.
Unable to forget the thrill of riding, Claire sneaks out at night. The Captain recognizes her despite an improvised disguise and promises secrecy.
Claire prepares to resign, believing her enjoyment of riding makes her unworthy. Bell and Scarlet insist she belongs at Candle Square as herself.

chapters.t: Then Came a Lot of Cleaning
chapters.s: Claire resolves to follow her own judgment rather than imitate Carnelia. A paperwork visit becomes a stern intervention over the Captain's untidy room.
Claire approaches the final trial ready to accept her past and choose her own way. She still hopes her colleagues will never learn her embarrassing secret.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Claire completes the Journey and plans a relaxed celebration. When the Captain vanishes, she trusts her judgment and leaves to find him.

stories.name: Scarlet
stories.label: Candle Square
stories.summary: Scarlet joins the Journey hoping to follow her grandmother's path as a legendary tailor. Her energy and pride cause trouble, but her delight in helping children reveals a generous heart. Expensive materials and flashy designs do not give her the answer she seeks. Making a simple coat for a cold child finally points her toward the craft's deeper purpose.

chapters.s: Scarlet breaks into the Captain's quarters after missing their meeting. The dragon maid introduces her ambition to become a Grand Couturier.
Scarlet shows a rare Bella petal and her inherited shears. She seeks a lost tailoring technique, but happily postpones study to play with children.
Scarlet uproots trees to stop children climbing them, accidentally displacing birds. She replants them before Claire arrives over another misguided improvement.
Scarlet seeks inspiration around town. Residents channel her energy into useful jobs, which she tackles with enormous enthusiasm.
Scarlet explains how curiosity and ideals protect long-lived dragons from erosion. Her attempt to demonstrate a mighty breath produces only smoke.
Scarlet makes the Captain an extravagant outfit to show her gratitude. Its startling design attracts attention she mistakes for admiration.
Scarlet skips a favorite play to help repair a festival rocket. Her unusual decorative solution becomes a spectacular firework display.
Scarlet helps find a lost child and quickly makes her a coat. Its unexpected warmth suggests care for the wearer may unlock her true craft.
With new confidence, Scarlet successfully embroiders the fragile Bella petal. She promises the Captain a charm before facing the final trial.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Scarlet completes the Journey and imagines searching for the Bella with the Captain. His disappearance becomes more urgent than meeting Alicia.

stories.name: Clarissa
stories.label: Canopus Rangers
stories.summary: Clarissa's teasing hides her fear of the blindness that eventually claims everyone in her tribe. Past failed searches for a cure have left the gifted sniper reluctant to give the Journey her full effort. The Captain's persistence and a new understanding of her blind father's life help her find the courage to keep trying. After completing the trial, she turns her hunter's determination toward finding the vanished Captain who promised to stay beside her.

chapters.s: Clarissa introduces herself through teasing and pranks, impressing the Captain with her extraordinary eyesight while keeping her reason for joining secret.
Bored with training, Clarissa proposes a competition and wins after concealing her true strength, earning a chance to prank the Captain.
The Captain discovers Clarissa feeding a sick stray cat. She avoids naming it and admits discomfort with the belief that cats go away to die.
An innocent prank covering Clarissa's eyes triggers terror. A dropped book reveals a connection between her tribe's exceptional vision and eventual blindness.
While camping, Clarissa explains her fear of losing her sight like her father and the unsuccessful search for an escape from her tribe's fate.

chapters.t: The Shooting Match, and the Spark
chapters.s: The Captain repeatedly challenges Clarissa to shooting matches and promises continued help. Their persistence inspires her to give the Journey her full effort.
Clarissa wins prizes for children at a rigged festival game. She and the Captain clear up their awkwardness and return to a warmer rapport.
Learning that sick cats seek safety changes Clarissa's view of her father's withdrawal. She resolves to contact him and lets herself grieve openly.
News that her father is hunting again renews Clarissa's hope. Before the final trial, she invites the Captain to visit home with her.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Clarissa finishes the Journey grateful for the courage to try again. When the Captain disappears, she sets out to track them down.

stories.name: Hilde
stories.label: Fenrir Squad
stories.summary: Hilde saves the Captain during a Voidborn attack and enters the Journey to return to her own world. Her ruthless practicality causes conflict until he learns how countless failed battles and the world’s rejection have worn her down. As the breach tied to her arrival worsens, the pair protects civilians and uses Dirac’s Well to confront the remaining flames of Asmodeus. With the danger contained, Hilde acknowledges the Captain’s resolve and prepares to leave Lavistar.

chapters.s: Hilde saves the Captain during a sudden Voidborn attack. Their formal meeting reveals a blunt, destructive hunter who is unhappy to learn that the Journey lasts a year.
Hilde needs the Stellar Archive to return to her own world. She turns training into dangerous rehabilitation for the recovering Captain by making him run from a monster.
An earthquake traps the pair with an injured explorer. Hilde blasts an exit through the ruins, prompting the Captain to challenge her willingness to risk a human life.
The Captain finds Hilde collapsed and appearing as several overlapping figures. Alicia explains that Lavistar rejects the exhausted traveler because she does not belong to this world.
Hilde explains that she crosses worlds to oppose an enemy she cannot yet defeat. Her arrival opened the breach that let Voidborns into NOA, and staying will worsen it.
The rescued explorer thanks the pair and reveals that their quick escape saved his life. Later, Hilde warns the Captain to make his own judgments rather than blindly trust Alicia.
The Captain takes Hilde through the New Year’s festival and explains why the path toward protecting peace matters to him. She quietly hopes his conviction will be rewarded.

chapters.t: A Flame That Burns the World
chapters.s: Hilde and the Captain defeat another sudden Voidborn incursion and save civilians. She suspects the creatures are fleeing a greater threat through the breach.
Alicia adapts Dirac’s Well so the final trial can give the breach’s lingering flames a defeatable form. Hilde and the Captain prepare to confront a projection of Asmodeus.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: The final trial contains the flames, allowing the breach to heal after Hilde departs. She acknowledges the Captain’s belief and prepares to return to her original world.

stories.name: Yoo Mina
stories.label: Fenrir Squad
stories.summary: Mina lands in Lavistar from another world and reluctantly enters the Journey as her only way home. Her insistence on handling everything alone eases when the Captain discovers that real missions suit her better than conventional training. Working and protecting one another reveals the financial worries and past losses behind her guarded behavior. Mina buys the Captain a cloak as thanks, completes the final trial and prepares to return home with a lingering belief that they will meet again.

chapters.s: Mina crashes into Lavistar and takes the Captain hostage out of suspicion. Alicia explains that completing a year-long Journey is the only way to return to her own world.
Mina makes little progress on conventional training but refuses help. The Captain chooses to observe her rather than force his guidance on someone determined to work alone.
A vigil for Candle Square’s cookie thief reveals that Mina took the snacks to save money. She, Scarlet and the Captain protect one another from blame but receive Claire’s lecture.
Mina and the Captain help Lisette’s crowded bazaar. When a Voidborn attacks, Mina’s striking improvement in real combat gives the Captain an idea for her training.
A successful monster quest confirms that real missions bring out Mina’s strength. The Captain adjusts their Journey around fieldwork, and she begins to trust his role.
Worried by Mina’s secret outings, the Captain discovers her working at a themed cafe. She is saving personal wages and invites him to the New Year’s festival.
A mistaken medical report makes Mina fiercely protective after the Captain is injured. Once the error is cleared up, she explains the past losses behind her fear of burdening others.
Mina returns with the Captain to where they first met and gives him an expensive cloak bought with her wages. It is both thanks and something tangible to remember her by.
Before the final trial, Mina admits some nerves but promises to fight through as a member of Fenrir Squad. She and the Captain prepare to face the projected Gille.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: Mina completes the Journey and prepares to return to her own world. Despite the Captain’s disappearance from the scene, she remembers his kindness and hopes they will meet again.

stories.name: Rosaria
stories.label: Fallen Hawk
stories.summary: A magical accident lets the Demon Lord Rosaria observe Lavistar, and Alicia arranges a Journey to contain the resulting dimensional danger. The Captain tries to motivate his demanding partner through her love of melodrama, leading to detective work and an extravagant festival performance. When the passage between worlds worsens, he insists on accompanying her into a final confrontation shaped by her stolen power. Rosaria brings their chaotic script to a successful end, then reveals that the Captain’s own ability interested her all along.

chapters.s: A struggle at a summoning circle lets Rosaria descend into Lavistar and tears the world’s boundary. Alicia asks the Demon Lord to join the Captain’s Journey to help contain the danger.
Rosaria spends Journey funds on luxurious furniture and treats the Captain as an errand runner. She reveals her contract to restrain the dimensional tear in return for NOA’s hospitality.
Rosaria turns an attempt to clear Muriel and Elisa of blame into a chaotic demonic spectacle. The Captain realizes that her love of scandalous drama could motivate her participation.
The promise of writing a festival play inspires Rosaria to gather material through a detective agency. Their first apparent kidnapping case turns out to be a dispute over a dog.
Reading Rosaria’s poor script unsettles the Captain, who tries to reach her through a fable-based film. Their argument over its logic leaves him reconsidering how to approach her.
Damage from their earlier case threatens the play’s costume order. The Captain and Rosaria revise the plans, then endure a Stellar Rangers marathon that gives her fresh ideas.
A real Voidborn attacks during the festival play while the audience mistakes it for spectacle. Rosaria appears as a magical girl and defeats it, turning the show into a success.
Rosaria notices the tear worsening despite her restraint. Alicia discovers that the circle created a passage between worlds and plans to destroy its sustaining core through Dirac’s Well.
The Captain insists on joining the operation as Rosaria’s servant. A core wielding her power recreates his nightmare, but the real Rosaria arrives and restages the confrontation.

chapters.t: At the End of the Journey
chapters.s: With the danger resolved, Rosaria follows the Captain through his attempted disappearance. She reveals her interest in his ability, then permits him to leave while reserving a future visit.
